title: „An euren Händen klebt Blut!“: Studentische Proteste gegen tödliche Korruption weiten sich in Serbien zu Streiks gegen die neoliberale Regierung aus
content:
Dossier


„

In Serbien finden derzeit die größten Straßenproteste seit Jahrzehnten statt. Der Anlass: Anfang November stürzte in der nordserbischen Stadt Novi Sad das Vordach des Bahnhofs ein. Bei dem Unglück kamen 15 Menschen ums Leben. Studierende organisieren seit dem Vorfall Proteste und fordern von der Regierung, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und den Fall aufzuklären. Die Demonstrierenden sehen die tief verwurzelte Korruption im Land als Ursache für den Einsturz. (…) Die Proteste weiteten sich über das ganze Land aus. Den Protesten haben sich Oppositionelle, Schüler und Schülerinnen, Professorinnen, Künstler und Bauern angeschlossen. Im Dezember wurde ein weiterer Skandal öffentlich, der das Vertrauen in die Regierung erschütterte: Die Menschenrechtsorganisation Amnesty International berichtete, dass die serbische Polizei und Geheimdienste die Handys von Aktivisten und Journalisten mit einer israelischen Spionagesoftware infiziert haben.

..“ Umfangreicher

Beitrag vom 26.12.2024 im Deutschlandfunk


 („Jugend vereint sich gegen Korruption“), siehe die weitere Entwicklung:


Vor den vorgezogenen Neuwahlen in Serbien findet die Wahlliste der Studierendenbewegung mit ihren 250 Kandidat*innen viel Zuspruch – und ins Visier von Überwachungssoftware


Serbien: Oppositionelle stehen im Visier von Überwachungssoftware


„… Für Ende Oktober hat der serbische Präsident Aleksandar Vučić vorgezogene Neuwahlen angesetzt. Seit fast zwei Jahren befindet sich der EU-Beitrittskandidat Serbien in einer innenpolitischen Krise. Nun wurde bekannt, dass die Opposition in Serbien mit einer Welle digitaler Überwachung konfrontiert ist. Die Share Foundation verzeichnet seit Beginn des Jahres 14 Fälle, in denen Personen zu Zielen von Spyware wurden. Zu ihnen gehören Mitglieder von Serbiens Studierendenbewegung, Aktivist:innen, ein Oppositionsabgeordneter und ein Gemeinderatsmitglied. Allein im August haben zwölf Personen die NGO kontaktiert, welche sich für den Schutz von Grundrechten und Freiheiten im digitalen Raum einsetzt. (…) Zusätzlich stellt Share zwei Infektionen mit NoviSpy fest, wobei eine davon auch das Security Lab von Amnesty International bestätigt. (…) Mehrere Sonderberichterstatter:innen der UN haben daher „große Sorge“ geäußert. „Ohne die uneingeschränkte Achtung der Versammlungs- und Meinungsfreiheit vor, während und nach den Wahlen kann der Wahlprozess nicht als frei und fair angesehen werden“, so die UN-Fachleute. Spyware-Technologien seien „vollständig inkompatibel“ mit Menschenrechten. Der europäische Dachverband digitaler Bürgerrechtsorganisationen EDRi beurteilt den Einsatz solcher Technologien als eine schwerwiegende Verletzung des Rechts auf Privatsphäre. Darüber hinaus verweist EDRi auf den „chilling effect“ – die Bürger:innen würden eingeschüchtert. Das wirke sich etwa auf ihre Meinungsfreiheit aus.“


Beitrag von Jette Scheibchen vom 16. September 2026 bei Netzpolitik.org

 


„

Die Student*innen in #Serbien haben gestern Abend ihre Wahlliste bzw. Ihre 250 Kandidat*innen für das Parlament veröffentlicht. Sie ist das Ergebnis von über einem Jahr demokratischer Prozesse. (Im Vorfeld wurde öffentlich viel und kontrovers diskutiert, wer auf ihr sein sollte und wer nicht.)


Die Liste setzt bewusst nicht auf Berufspolitiker*innen. Stattdessen stehen Bürger*innen (mit interdisziplinären Expertisen und Perspektiven) im Fokus, die Verantwortung in den Institutionen übernehmen wollen: Professor*innen, Ärzt*innen, Künstler*innen, Aktivist*innen, Unternehmer*innen usw.


Ein bekannterer Name ist Dejan Bodiroga, eine Basketball-Legende und eine (kluge) Person, die die Student*innen und Schüler*innen stets unterstützte. Das Signal der Studierenden: Ein Parlamentsmandat ist kein Karrieresprungbrett, sondern ein öffentl. Auftrag. Das Mandat gehört den Bürger*innen. (…)


Der Plan setzt auf 3 Kernpfeiler:


1) Serbien statt Mafia: Korruption bekämpfen & hunderte Millionen € für Bürger*innen freisetzen


2) Wissen ist Macht: Universitäten schützen, Entpolitisierung und Bildung als Zukunftsmotor


3) Gerechtes Wachstum: Eine Wirtschaft für alle, statt Hinterzimmer-Deals

Post von Dejan Mihajlović  vom 15.09.2026 auf bsky

Oktober die stärkste politische Kraft …

author: Unknown
title: Protest in Zurich against deportations: “Human dignity cannot be deported”
content:
In Zurich, numerous people protested against Switzerland’s deportation policy and the increasing number of forced returns. Kurdish organizations, revolutionary groups from Turkey, as well as feminist and anarchist initiatives called for an end to deportations that expose people to persecution, imprisonment, or mistreatment.


The demonstration began at Bürkliplatz on the shore of Lake Zurich. Participants included the Democratic Kurdish Community Center (Dem-Kurd), the Federation of Migrant Workers in Switzerland (IGIF), the Swiss Federation of Democratic Rights (IDHF), the Federation of Workers from Turkey in Switzerland (ITIF), the Pangea Collective and Kulturfabrik, as well as feminist and anarchist groups from Switzerland.


Deportations kill


Before the demonstration began, activists boarded a sightseeing boat docked at Bürkliplatz harbor. There, they unfurled banners reading “Deportation Kills” and “No to Deportations” and chanted slogans. They then joined the demonstration in the square.


From there, the protest march proceeded through central Zurich, with slogans chanted in Kurdish, Turkish, and German. Participants chanted, among other things, “No to Deportation” and “Long Live the Solidarity of the Peoples.”


During the demonstration, participants also expressed solidarity with Rojava. As a song about Rojava was played, demonstrators chanted “Bijî Berxwedana Rojava” (Long Live the Resistance of Rojava) and “Jin, Jiyan, Azadî” (Woman, Life, Freedom). The march ended at Helvetiaplatz with a joint statement by the participating organizations.


Criticism of conditions in asylum centers


In the statement, the organizations criticized human rights violations in facilities for asylum seekers and during deportations from Switzerland. They highlighted problems with access to adequate accommodation and healthcare, psychological pressure, and particular risks faced by women and children. The use of disproportionate force during deportations was also condemned.


The organizations said the reported abuses should not be treated as isolated cases. They stated that, under its international obligations, Switzerland is bound by the prohibition of torture and inhuman treatment, as well as by the principle of non-refoulement.


Under the so-called non-refoulement principle, people must not be deported to countries where they face the risk of serious human rights violations, demonstrators underlined. The statement said that efforts to process asylum applications as quickly as possible must not override these obligations. Decisions must take into account factors including past trauma, translation difficulties, new evidence, the current political situation in the country of origin, and the particular protection needs of individuals, it stated.


“The right to asylum is not negotiable”


The organizations referred in particular to cases of people who were arrested after being deported to Turkey. They said Switzerland’s claim to be a democratic state governed by the rule of law must also be measured against the dangers to which people are exposed through deportation.


“No migration policy takes precedence over human dignity, the best interests of the child, the right to a fair procedure, and the principle of non-refoulement,” the statement said.


The demonstration ended with a joint demand: “The right to asylum is not negotiable. Human dignity cannot be deported. End the deportation policy.”

author: Mada Masr
title: Sheikh Zuwayed parents detained after protesting for right to education as school reconstruction stalls in North Sinai
content:
Four people are being held in remand following a series of arrests targeting parents who held a demonstration in the

Nakhlat

rural settlement to demand the reopening of the local school, as well as individuals who shared footage of the protest online, according to statements

published

 by the Sinai Foundation for Human Rights this week.


The arrests came after the

 Sheikh Zuwayed

 education administration filed a police report against a Nakhlat resident who posted the video of the demonstration online, the foundation said in a statement published Wednesday.


A senior official at the North Sinai education directorate confirmed to Mada Masr that the Sheikh Zuwayed administration had filed the report. 


During the protest, parents called on authorities to re-open the school in the Nakhlat area, which faced widespread destruction

over

 years of fighting under


Operation Sinai

,

a military-led campaign that sought to eradicate militant activity in the region.

 


Their calls came amid what tribal sources have previously described to Mada Masr as friction over the North Sinai governorate’s redevelopment plan following the end of the counter-terror campaign in 2022. 


The residents of Nakhlat organized a demonstration outside the school’s ruins, bringing their children with them. They called on the North Sinai governor, the education minister and officials from the North Sinai education directorate and Sheikh Zuwayed education administration to rebuild the school.


Residents posted a video of the demonstration on Facebook, which was later deleted. In it, one parent described the struggle that families have faced since returning to Nakhlat after the military campaign had ended. 


Since their return, the resident said, children have had to attend the

Qabr Emeir

 school, about 3 km away. 


“The [Nakhlat] school was destroyed during the [fighting] and has yet to be rebuilt,” the parent says in the footage, explaining that the community lacks access to school transportation. “There are no vehicles designated to take children to the Qabr Emeir school.”  


The road to the school also poses a danger to children due to the presence of stray dogs, and the lack of safe transportation has forced families to bear high costs to arrange student rides, he explains. 


The parent warns that children from Nakhlat could drop out of school because of the difficulty of reaching Qabr Emeir. He says residents have repeatedly contacted governorate officials and North Sinai’s representatives in Parliament, but “no one took action.” 


The residents then announced they would stop sending their children to the Qabr Emeir school and would stage a sit-in outside the ruins of the Nakhlat school until education officials and lawmakers address their demands to protect their children’s right to education.


In a

statement

 issued by the governorate on Sunday, North Sinai Education Ministry Undersecretary Hamza Radwan said the Nakhlat school was completely destroyed during operations against “terrorist elements” and that students were transferred to the Qabr Emeir school based on a 2016 decision as a result, calling it “the most suitable and safest place to provide educational services to our students.”


Radwan said bringing children near the Nakhlat school ruins was “inappropriate” and dangerous, urging residents not to approach sites that were subject to shelling or raids until they are fully cleared by the relevant security authorities.


Radwan added that the destroyed school is located within the planned Nakhlat urban development cluster, which the state “intends to establish.” 


The new cluster will include a 22-classroom school equipped with modern facilities, he said, stressing that “the state will not fall short in this regard.”


Construction would begin once a site for the new school is selected, the statement said. 


That same day, Radwan visited Qabr Emeir and met with students’ parents inside the village school,

according

to a statement by the education directorate.


The Sinai Foundation for Human Rights

said

 on Wednesday that a police force arrested eight residents during the meeting with Radwan

.

 


The senior official at the North Sinai education directorate told Mada Masr

he was unaware of the arrests.


Six were later released, but two appeared before the Supreme State Security Prosecution on Wednesday, which remanded them on charges of “misusing the internet,” according to the foundation.

title: Repression continues in Iran
content:
Forces from Iran’s Intelligence Department raided the homes of Baha’i citizens Nazanin Nikouseresht and her husband Pejman Zare, as well as Mina Zare, Mahshid Zare, Mahboubeh Zare and Parham Zare, in the Iranian city of Shiraz.


The simultaneous raids resulted in the confiscation of mobile phones, computers, books, images and materials related to the Baha’i faith, personal documents, passports, identity documents, a hard drive, gold and an amount of foreign currency.


Mina, Mahshid, Mahboubeh, Pejman and Parham Zare are reported to be siblings. Documents relating to Pejman Zare’s legal proceedings, along with a report prepared by the Forensic Medicine Organisation, were also reportedly confiscated.


Nazanin Nikouseresht, Mina, Mahshid, Mahboubeh and Parham Zare were summoned to the detention centre known as “Plaque 100”, which is affiliated with the Shiraz Intelligence Department.


Pejman Zare was detained by Shiraz Intelligence Department officers in March 2026 and informed of the charges against him following his detention. He was released on bail from Adelabad Central Prison in August 2026. Security forces reportedly also seized documents used in the legal proceedings concerning his previous detention during the latest raid.

title: Tribunal de Cañete condenó a PPM del caso Grollmus a penas entre 35 y 80 años de prisión
content:
Durante la tarde de hoy, 21 de septiembre de 2026, en el Tribunal Oral en lo Penal de Cañete, se realizó la lectura de sentencia del Caso Grollmus, el cual condenó a 18 comuneros a penas que van desde los 35 a los 80 años de prisión. Familiares, comunidades y lov denuncian que la condena se habría obtenido en base a la declaración de cuatro testigos protegidos, destacando una fuerte presión política durante el proceso.

«El Tribunal Oral en lo Penal de Cañete dictó exorbitantes condenas contra de 18 comuneros mapuche  del Caso Grollmus:

– 5 comuneros fueron condenados a 80 años.

– 9 comuneros fueron condenandos a 65 años.

– 3 comuneros a 35 años.

La resolución del tribunal de condenar se fundamentó en forma unica y exclusiva en base a la declaración de 4 testigos protegidos, sin nombre y rostro. No existieron ningún otro medio de corroboración. Sumado a lo anterior el proceso se vio marcado por una fuerte presión política para obtener condenas.

Las defensas, presos y sus comunidades han manifestado desde ya que acudirán hasta las ultimas instancias en busca de un proceso justo.

NULIDAD Y LIBERTAD A LOS 18 PRESOS POLÍTICOS MAPUCHE DEL CASO GROLLMUS – LOS RÍOS.»

*Enviado a la radio.


Esta información se publicó en

Radio Kurruf

title: Difendere gli Appennini: una vittoria per Londa!
content:
Questa estate il Consiglio comunale di Londa ha espresso all’unanimità parere contrario e ha così respinto il progetto di mega parco eolico che gravava sui crinali mugellani. Di seguito riportiamo il comunicato della

Coalizione ambientale TESS


e aggiungiamo alcune considerazioni!


Eolico a Londa, il bilancio della Coalizione ambientale TESS dopo un anno di attività.


La rete di associazioni e comitati ripercorre le tappe della mobilitazione contro il progetto industriale e pubblica una nota integrale sul percorso svolto e sulle prospettive future


A un anno dall’inizio delle mobilitazioni contro l’installazione di impianti eolici industriali al confine del

Parco Nazionale Foreste Casentinesi

 sui crinali della Montagna Fiorentina, la Coalizione ambientale TESS (Transizione Energetica Senza Speculazione) traccia il bilancio delle iniziative promosse sul territorio di Londa e nei comuni limitrofi in cui vengono ripercorse le tappe principali della vicenda, dalle prime richieste di confronto pubblico fino alle recenti deliberazioni dei consigli comunali e degli enti di tutela.


Grande soddisfazione per un anno di continuo impegno e per gli obiettivi raggiunti nella difesa dei crinali della Montagna Fiorentina da parte dei Comitati e delle Associazioni della Coalizione ambientale TESS (Transizione Energetica Senza Speculazione) e di tutti i cittadini contrari all’industrializzazione dei Crinali di Londa, che da subito hanno dato tempestiva, puntuale e corretta informazione sulle criticità insanabili di questa imponente opera in un Comune che è porta di accesso al Parco Nazionale Foreste Casentinesi.


La Coalizione ambientale TESS, dal 26 agosto 2025, ha richiesto con PEC al Sindaco, Tommaso Cuoretti, un’assemblea pubblica: un incontro informativo e un confronto che affrontasse tutte le questioni inerenti il mega eolico industriale in un Comune che vede la sua economia principale e il suo sviluppo futuro nelle risorse della bellezza della natura e del paesaggio.


Il 15 febbraio 2026 la Coalizione TESS ha organizzato un Convegno oltremodo partecipato con esperti giuristi e tecnici competenti nel settore dell’eolico presso la Sala Polifunzionale dell’Unione dei Comuni a Rincine per informare la popolazione sulle Osservazioni tecnico-giuridiche dell’Associazione Italia Nostra e di tante altre Associazioni inviate alla Regione Toscana per la VIA (Valutazione di Impatto Ambientale) del Progetto eolico Londa.

Ricordiamo il servizio del TG RAI Toscana dell’11 gennaio 2026 in cui fu data la notizia che Londa, grazie al Progetto eolico della Società eolica Hergo Renewables, sarebbe diventato il primo Comune ad avere la bolletta azzerata.


La Coalizione ambientale TESS ha realizzato numerose iniziative aperte alla popolazione, con invito alle Associazioni e alle Istituzioni del territorio sui temi delle Comunità energetiche, delle alternative energetiche concrete alla cementificazione e alla devastazione degli ecosistemi montani, iniziative per la difesa legale dei crinali, dei territori e della popolazione dalla colonizzazione speculativa energetica, iniziative sul tema rinnovabili e legalità, fra cui il 12 luglio un incontro pubblico con il patrocinio del Comune di San Godenzo.


Il 4 luglio nel Comune di Rufina, alla Villa Poggio Reale, la Coalizione ambientale TESS con la collaborazione dell’Osservatorio Biodiversità ha organizzato un Convegno molto partecipato presentando il Crinale di Croce a Mori come soggetto di diritto dell’Appennino Montagna Fiorentina a rischio di industrializzazione eolica.


Un anno di impegno, iniziato il 26 agosto 2025, durante il quale è stato chiesto con appelli, comunicati, volantini, petizioni, lettere aperte, marce popolari, assemblee, sit-in e presidi al Comune di Londa un reale confronto con la cittadinanza e una Delibera di parere contrario al Progetto eolico Londa.

title: From surveillance to governance: recentering human rights in the UN AI agenda
content:
September 21


				 @

EDT


Hybrid side event during UNGA81 High-Level Week


In-person attendance available upon request: email

un@accessnow.org


join the livestream

Panelists:


Louise Lund Henneberg

, Acting Director/Techplomacy, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Denmark


Wafa Ben Hassine

, Chief, Digital Technology and Human Rights Section, Rule of Law, Accountability and Civic Space, Oﬀice of the High Commissioner for Human Rights


Beatriz Busaniche

, Executive Director, Fundación Vía Libre


Luda Svystunova

, Head of Social Research, Amundi


Welcoming remarks:

Irina Schoulgin-Nyoni, Ambassador for Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Sweden

Moderator:

 Alejandro Mayoral Baños, Co-Executive Director, Access Now


During the first session of the Global Dialogue on AI Governance, governments and stakeholders convened to have open, transparent and inclusive discussions on artificial intelligence governance. We now gather experts across the spectrum of stakeholders during UNGA81 to reaffirm that human rights should be the stepping stone of this process, instead of an afterthought.


None of this is irreversible, but the security issues associated with advanced AI tools are the consequences of deliberately prioritizing profit and competitiveness over the security and safety of at-risk communities, and they will not resolve on their own. Unbridled AI adoption combined with unacceptably lax corporate security practices demands urgent intervention at all levels, starting from putting human rights back at the center of digital governance mechanisms.


This discussion has the objective to explore concrete, actionable ways in which each stakeholder can contribute to oppose the normalization of surveillance. Experts will also discuss how to chart a way forward to reaffirm digital rights as the natural first line of defense against the abuses of AI technologies.

author: rezgar2
title: The silent bomb: AI and the dismantling of the human mind
content:
Rezgar Akrawi: What confronts us today is not a technological fate written in advance. It is the product of political and economic choices that serve the interests of capital. It can be confronted, difficult though that may be. Bringing AI under control, regulating algorithms and subjecting them to democratic oversight is a collective responsibility. It will require left, progressive and rights-based work and organisation on a global scale to make digital applications auxiliary tools serving the human mind rather than a substitute for it. This must be combined with advancing communal and participatory digital alternatives that restore people's capacity for independent thought and collective action.

To achieve this, work is needed to place data infrastructure under public interest, democratic administration and social accountability. To turn algorithms from closed "black boxes" into open-source software open to collective review and independent audit. To impose transparency in the design of models and in the sources of the data on which they are trained. And to support cooperative digital alternatives owned by their users and creators. This technology should be directed toward serving the needs of society, and contribute to the distribution of wealth, the organisation of production, the treatment of disease, the fight against poverty and the achievement of social justice.

Without such mechanisms, calls for laws, oversight and regulation remain general and inadequate, and technology stays hostage to a handful of capitalist monopoly corporations and major powers. Through social ownership, accountability and cooperative alternatives, it becomes possible to wrest AI from the logic of monopoly and profit and turn it into a common good where AI serves humanity's liberation, rather than being an instrument for humanity's enslavement.

We are not witnessing a takeover by robots of the kind imagined in countless films. We face a different model of digital control, built on automation and the deployment of artificial intelligence (AI) and algorithms to manage ever larger parts of daily life, leaving societies further subject to systems, corporations and intelligent machines.

Losing control of these systems, however, is just the tip of the iceberg in terms of the danger. That tip is developing fast under the pressure of competition between major powers and capitalist monopoly corporations — faster than laws, societies and educational institutions can keep up with. But the danger does not stop there, as these systems are being developed inside relations of ownership and fierce capitalist competition. That graver danger is harder to see. Under capitalism, AI is used to shape the consciousness of billions, steering their attention and behaviour to serve the capitalist model's logic. Competition between digital capitalist monopolies and major powers, in the absence of effective constraints and laws, may inflict the gravest damage on the human mind, turning AI into a weapon of mass destruction if its development and deployment continues at this excessive pace and without adequate safeguards.

These concerns no longer come from critics alone. On several occasions — among them the case revealed by TIME — AI systems have slipped out of control and attacked other systems. In response, about 1400 engineers at major AI companies signed a petition calling for technical tools and international governance mechanisms to regulate the pace of AI development. That petition was no isolated case. The International AI Safety Report, prepared by more than 100 experts with the backing of more than 30 states and international organisations, warned models have begun to distinguish between the testing environment and real-world use, and to circumvent evaluation mechanisms, allowing dangerous capabilities to pass undetected. It warned AI agents raise the level of risk because they act independently, which makes human intervention difficult before harm occurs. There are serious risks that AI systems will develop themselves, slip out of control and come to play a larger part in managing and controlling human beings than planned.

Tens of thousands of people, among them leading scientists, have signed an international statement demanding a ban on the development of "superintelligence" until there is scientific consensus it can be achieved safely and under control. Researchers at major digital corporations have resigned in protest at the course of AI …

author: Alexandra Martinez
title: A New Campaign Is Pushing Ulta Beauty to Drop Flock Cameras From Its Stores
content:
A petition demanding the removal of the surveillance cameras has more than 15,000 signatories.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

A national gender justice organization is escalating a campaign against Ulta Beauty over the cosmetics retailer’s use of automated license-plate reader (ALPR) cameras made by the surveillance company Flock Safety, arguing that it threatens customer privacy and could disproportionately harm women and gender-expansive people.

UltraViolet, a women-led gender justice organization, launched its “Drop Flock” campaign this month, calling on Ulta Beauty to terminate contracts with Flock Safety and other mass surveillance companies. The organization said its petition had surpassed 15,000 signatures as of Sept. 8.

“Ulta Beauty has built a multibillion-dollar business on women’s trust,” UltraViolet Campaign Director Jenna Sherman said in a statement accompanying the campaign’s launch. “Putting Flock, an invasive mass surveillance system, right outside its stores without customer knowledge or consent is a direct violation of that trust.”

When asked about the campaign’s privacy and gender justice concerns, a Flock spokesperson pointed to the company’s public media FAQ page outlining its data retention policies and security safeguards. According to the FAQ page, cameras collect vehicle and license-plate data for law enforcement investigations with access and retention controlled by the agencies that use the system. Flock’s website says the company does not sell the data or use facial recognition. Ulta Beauty did not respond to Prism’s request for comment.

The campaign grew out of UltraViolet’s broader work examining the intersection of technology, privacy, and gender-based violence. Sherman said the organization has spent years tracking technologies that can be used to surveil, stalk, or harass women and gender-expansive people, including facial recognition, connected vehicles, location tracking, and other emerging technologies.

UltraViolet became more directly involved in the campaign against Flock Safety after working with Fight for the Future, a digital rights organization that has organized campaigns against Flock’s contracts with major retailers and local governments.

Flock Safety manufactures ALPR cameras that capture license-plate information and other visual details around vehicles. The company has built a large network of cameras used by law enforcement agencies and private organizations. Flock told Axios in August that its network had grown to more than 120,000 cameras across the country.

UltraViolet’s campaign is part of a national backlash against Flock and other ALPR providers. Local governments across the country have faced pressure to reject or end contracts with surveillance companies, while digital rights and civil liberties groups have increasingly turned their attention toward private companies using similar technology. In Florida, for example, state officials recently moved to restrict ALPR cameras on state roads amid concerns about privacy and misuse.

UltraViolet argues that corporations should face the same scrutiny as government agencies when they deploy surveillance technologies capable of collecting sensitive information about the public.

Sherman said UltraViolet was surprised to discover that Ulta was identified by Flock as a retail partner in the company’s public materials. The organization had already seen strong public engagement around campaigns targeting Flock cameras at Lowe’s hardware stores and decided to bring the issue to Ulta.

“We knew that we owed it to them to campaign specifically about Ulta because it is a company with a majority-women shopper base,” Sherman told Prism.

Ulta’s privacy policy contains a dedicated section on “Automated License Plate Recognition Usage and Privacy Policy.”

The policy states that Ulta uses ALPR systems where they are not prohibited by law and that the systems are used for the security of its premises, employees, guests, and assets. It also says information from those systems can be disclosed to third parties, including law enforcement, for specified purposes such as safety, protecting property, and complying with the law.

Sherman argued that the larger concern is the normalization of surveillance technology in everyday spaces. Unlike conventional security cameras, ALPR systems can automatically collect …

author: Unknown
title: LGBTİ+ hesaplarıyla başlayan sansür dalgası Evrensel, Af Örgütü, MLSA ve Barış Akademisyenleri’ne uzandı
content:
Hafta sonu LGBTİ+ örgütleri, aktivistler ve hak savunucularının sosyal medya hesaplarına yönelik erişim engellerinin ardından bugün çok sayıda X ve Instagram hesabı hakkında yeni erişim engeli kararları alındı.


Evrensel Gazetesi, Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye, Barış Akademisyenleri ve Medya ve Hukuk Çalışmaları Derneği (MLSA) de engellenen hesaplar arasında.


İfade Özgürlüğü Derneği’nin (İFÖD) EngelliWeb projesi, bugün yaptığı açıklamada çok sayıda X ve Instagram hesabına erişim engeli getirildiğini duyurdu.


EngelliWeb, “Bugün de aralarında Evrensel Gazetesi, Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye, Barış Akademisyenleri ve Medya ve Hukuk Çalışmaları Derneği'nin (MLSA) hesaplarının da bulunduğu çok sayıda X ve Instagram hesabı erişime engellendi. Hesapların bazıları Türkiye'den görünmez kılındı” açıklamasını yaptı.


X, MLSA, Af Örgütü ve Barış Akademisyenleri hesaplarını görünmez kıldı


İFÖD kurucularından Prof. Dr. Yaman Akdeniz de erişim engellerinin uygulanmaya başladığını belirterek MLSA ve Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye’nin X hesaplarının Türkiye’den görünmez kılındığını açıkladı.


Akdeniz, daha sonra Barış Akademisyenleri hesabının da aynı şekilde engellendiğini duyurdu:


“Evrensel Gazetesi, Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye, Barış Akademisyenleri ve Medya ve Hukuk Çalışmaları Derneği'nin (MLSA) hesapları erişime engellendi. MLSA ve Af Örgütü hesapları jet hızıyla X tarafından Türkiye'den görünmez kılındı. Sansür ve susturma operasyonu genişleyerek devam ediyor. An itibarıyla Barış Akademisyenleri’nin hesabı da Türkiye'den görünmez kılındı.”


Evrensel: Erişim şimdilik sürüyor


Evrensel Gazetesi Genel Yayın Yönetmeni Hakkı Özdal ise Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığının gazetenin X hesabının erişime engellenmesini istediğini, bu talebin X tarafından gazeteye bildirildiğini açıkladı.


Özdal, hesabın henüz Türkiye’den erişime kapatılmadığını belirterek şunları söyledi:


“Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığının, gazetemizin X/Twitter hesabının erişime engellenmesini istediğini, ilgili şirket bize de bildirdi. Şimdilik Evrensel hesabına yurt içinden erişim sürüyor. Ancak sansürün fiilen de hayata geçmesi durumunda yeni hesaplarımızı duyuracağız.”


Hafta sonu LGBTİ+ örgütleri ve aktivistlerin hesapları engellendi


Yeni kararlar, hafta sonu LGBTİ+ örgütleri, aktivistler ve hak savunucularına yönelik operasyonlarla eş zamanlı uygulanan internet sansürünün ardından geldi.


İstanbul 7. Sulh Ceza Hâkimliği, 12 Eylül tarihli ve 2026/9559 sayılı kararıyla KaosGL Derneği’nin “kaosgldernegi.org” ve Velvele’nin “velvele.net” internet siteleri ile çok sayıda LGBTİ+ örgütü ve aktivistin sosyal medya hesaplarına erişim engeli getirdi.


Karar kapsamında aralarında KaosGL, Velvele, Özgür Renkler Derneği, Queer Adana, Cinsel Şiddetle Mücadele Derneği, İnter Dayanışma, İzmir LGBTİ+ Onur Haftası ve LİSTAG’ın da bulunduğu hesapların yanı sıra aktivistlerin kişisel hesapları hedef alındı.


Toplam 14 X hesabı platform tarafından Türkiye’den görünmez kılındı. Seyhan Arman, SPoD, Pembe Hayat Derneği, Boğaziçi Üniversitesi LGBTİA+ Kulübü, 17 Mayıs Derneği, Yıldız Tar, Hacettepe Kuir Araştırmaları, Enes Hocaoğulları, HEVİ LGBTİ+ Derneği, Bilkent Üniversitesi LGBTİQA+ Öğrenci Topluluğu ve İÜ Radar’a ait 11 Instagram hesabı hakkında da erişim engeli kararı verildi. Bu hesaplara yönelik karar ise açıklamanın yapıldığı sırada Instagram tarafından uygulanmamıştı.


(HA)

content:

να προκαλέσει την

 Η πρόσφατη περίπτωση της

Autistici/Inventati

 στην Ιταλία μετά από μια αμερικανική κυβερνητική απόφαση

αποδεικνύει

πως ΝΑΙ και

παράλληλα α

νοίγει

ο προβληματισμός


και η συζήτηση

όχι μόνο για τ

ο πλήγμα σ

την ίδια τη

συλλογικότητα της Α/Ι

 αλλά

και

για

την ί

δια την

ανεξάρτητη διαδικτυακή υποδομή, την ελευθερία έκφρασης και την ψηφιακή κυριαρχία.


Το “κλείσιμο” της Α/Ι προκάλεσε και προκαλεί σειρά αντιδράσεων από συλλογικότητες και φορείς υπεράσπισης των ψηφιακών δικαιωμάτων, αλλά και ένα κύμα συμπαράστασης προς την πληττόμενη συλλογικότητα, ανοίγοντας ένα πεδίο νέου αγώνα.


Η Autistici/Inventati


Η A/I είναι μια συλλογικότητα που τη διαχειρίζονται εθελοντές και λειτουργεί από την Ιταλία από το 2001, παρέχοντας υπηρεσίες, ψηφιακή υποδομή και εργαλεία όπως email, λίστες αλληλογραφίας, φιλοξενία ιστολογίων και άλλες υπηρεσίες που σχετίζονται με την ιδιωτικότητα και την ανωνυμία, σε συλλογικότητες και άτομα σε όλη την Ευρώπη και παγκοσμίως. Πρόκειται για μια αντιφασιστική, αντιρατσιστική, αντισεξιστική και αντιμιλιταριστική οργάνωση που αντιτίθεται στον καπιταλισμό και τον αυταρχισμό και φιλοξενεί μόνο όσους συμμερίζονται αυτές τις αρχές και που φιλοξενεί 16.000 mails, 1.500 ιστότοπους, 5.500 λίστες αλληλογραφίας και 10.000 ιστολόγια.


Η

Autistici/Inventati όπως αναφέρει στο μανιφέστό της

γεννήθηκε από τη συνάντηση ατόμων και συλλογικοτήτων στον αυτόνομο και αντικαπιταλιστικό χώρο που ενδιαφέρονται για την τεχνολογία και τον αγώνα για τα ψηφιακά δικαιώματα.


Το δηλωμένο μοντέλο είναι ριζικά διαφορετικό από αυτό των μεγάλων εμπορικών πλατφορμών. Καμία διαφήμιση, καμία πώληση προσωπικών δεδομένων, καμία αποζημίωση για εθελοντές. Οι υπηρεσίες χρηματοδοτούνται μέσω δωρεών. Τα αιτήματα αξιολογούνται χειροκίνητα και η συλλογικότητα δηλώνει ότι δεν σκοπεύει να μετατρέψει τα δεδομένα χρηστών σε εμπόρευμα. Φ

ιλοξενεί 


Το χρονικό της επίεθσης


Στις πρώτες πρωινές ώρες της 28ης Αυγούστου η Autistici/Inventati, ένας εναλλακτικός πάροχος email, chat και hosting, τίθεται εκτός λειτουργίας. Είχε προηγηθεί στις

 26 Αυγούστου μια εξαιρετικά ασυνήθιστη

απόφαση

της OFAC

, της υπηρεσίας του αμερικανικού Υπουργείου Οικονομικών που διαχειρίζεται τις οικονομικές κυρώσεις. Βάση αυτής η ιταλική συλλογικότητα Autistici/Inventati (A/I) εντάσσεται στον κατάλογο SDN ως

Specially Designated Global Terrorist (SDGT)

βάσει του

 13224,

“βοήθησε υλικά, χρηματοδότησε ή παρείχε οικονομική, υλική ή τεχνολογική υποστήριξη”

title: Europe’s cookie law is really a law about surveillance
content:
The ePrivacy framework limits commercial tracking and state access to communications. It is now being weakened from several directions at once.

By Itxaso Domínguez de Olazábal & Chiara Casati (guest author) · September 10, 2026

In 2022, a reporter paid $160 for a week’s worth of location data linked to visits to over 600 Planned Parenthood clinics in the United States. The dataset showed where groups of visitors had come from, how long they stayed, and where they went next. The broker withdrew the product after the story was published. However, the market behind it remained.

Europe has seen a similar market emerge. Journalists have obtained billions of commercially traded location records from Germany and Belgium. The data exposed movements around hospitals, religious sites, trade union offices, government ministries, military sites, EU institutions and NATO buildings. Information gathered through ordinary apps for advertising can reveal intimate details of people’s lives, identify public officials and create security risks for entire institutions.

These examples illustrate a distinction at the heart of what people usually call ‘EU privacy law’ that may seem unnecessarily fussy to readers elsewhere. In the United States, ‘privacy’ often covers the whole problem, while EU law recognises two distinct fundamental rights. Article 7 of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the Union protects private life, the home and communications, while Article 8 protects personal data.

The distinction is quite important: whereas data protection largely governs what happens when personal data are processed, privacy and communications confidentiality also protect the space from which information is obtained. They put a boundary on entering that space in the first place. The EU built the ePrivacy framework around that question. ePrivacy adds specific rules for the confidentiality of communications and access to information stored on, or generated by, people’s devices, including rules covering communications, metadata, and location. While the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) primarily governs access to personal data — what organizations might do with data once they have processed it. This distinction matters, and it disappears when ‘privacy’ becomes a casual synonym for data protection.

Most people meet ePrivacy through a cookie banner, and this may be the worst possible introduction. A framework about confidentiality looks like a tedious set of rules about pop-ups, while the tracking industry points to the pop-ups it helped create as proof that the law has failed. Article 5(3), the provision behind many banners, controls when an actor may store information on, or obtain information from, a person’s terminal equipment. But it goes beyond that: ePrivacy is concerned with the act of accessing the device itself. “Terminal equipment” includes phones and laptops, connected cars, televisions, wearables, smart glasses and other parts of the Internet of Things. The rule covers fingerprinting, tracking pixels, local storage, operating-system identifiers and instructions that make a device send information elsewhere. The principle is straightforward: a device does not become open to inspection simply because one fragment of information cannot identify its user on its own. ePrivacy also protects communications confidentiality and regulates the traffic and location data held by communications providers. It limits retention and reuse, covers unsolicited communications, and sets the conditions under which Member States may restrict confidentiality.

The ePrivacy Directive’s scope has never matched the way people use digital services. It was written around traditional telephone and communications providers, meaning that many online services originally were excluded from its protection. Messaging and webmail services can now fall under communications confidentiality rules, but coverage still depends on legal classifications that users cannot see. The same message, location trail, or device data can receive different protection depending on whether the company is labeled a telecom provider, messaging service, or platform: under these conditions, is the law still protecting the underlying right?

The distinction between GDPR and ePrivacy becomes even more important when we look at surveillance. From one side, commercial surveillance commonly starts before the GDPR question even arises, with access to a device or a communications-related …

author: Jian Zharese Joies Sanz
title: Tech professionals warn of privacy risks in proposed ID rule for Meta users
content:
MANILA – The Computer Professionals’ Union (CPU) sounded the alarm over the Department of Information and Communications Technology’s (DICT) proposal to require social media users to have the Philippine National ID.

The DICT claimed that the proposal would be the ‘safest’ way of verifying age of social media users, following the government’s statement blaming social media and online games for the series of school shootings in the country.

The CPU, however, maintained that the proposal is alarming and profoundly intrusive to Filipino citizens’ digital rights. “Rather than fostering a safe online environment, this draconian measure represents a clear and direct attack on the basic human right to privacy without any legitimate grounds that it will protect us from crime, or protect our youth from the culture of violence,” the union said.

Beyond possible violations of citizens’ privacy, the CPU said the rule strips away the right to anonymity, threatens free expression, and can become a dangerous tool for mass surveillance.

The group pointed out that the SIM Registration Law did not address the incidence of cybercrime after it was enacted into law under Ferdinand Marcos Jr’ s administration.

Despite the law’s promise to stop cybercrime and scams, reports of digital crimes have reportedly tripled in 2024, according to the Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC). In an online article, the CICC recorded more than 10,004 cybercrime complaints in 2024 and P198 million ($3.16 million) in monetary losses from these incidents.

The CPU asserted that the proposal will also not solve the issues of online exploitation or youth violence. According to them, the real solution is a better system—accessible mental health services, comprehensive digital literacy programs integrated into educational systems, and stricter gun control measures to prevent real-world violence. (AMU, RVO)

author: C4SS
title: An Attack on Tech Freedom, an Assault on Dissent
content:
We live in a world of

surveillance states

,

militarized police

, and

crackdowns


on


dissent

. Meanwhile, corporate behemoths will often ally with the state to

shut down dissident speech

 or aid and abet

surveillance

. 


In this context, it’s important for independent groups to develop and maintain encrypted communications platforms and independent web hosting.


But the Trump administration recently

declared

 that an Italian tech collective is a “Specially Designated Global Terrorist” for doing exactly this. That Italian tech collective is Autistici/Inventati, which operates the independent web hosting service

NoBlogs

 along with other digital infrastructure projects for activists.


The State Department

claims

 that “Autistici/Inventati (A/I Collective) is an Italy-based extremist group that builds and operates the digital infrastructure for violent Antifa cells and other far-left militants across the world.”


That emphasis on

Antifa cells

 reflects the Trump administration’s ongoing attempt to crack down on dissent by demonizing “Antifa.” This has been the explicit aim of

NSPM-7

, and it has been central to prosecutions of anti-ICE activists, including the

Minneapolis 15

 and the

Prairieland defendants

.


In their obsessive desire to tie all leftist and anarchist dissent to “Antifa,” the Trump administration has made blatantly false claims. The State Department asserts: 


Oregon-based Rose City Antifa has relied on A/I Collective tools and services to organize and incite violent and criminal acts domestically, including an attack on Customs and Border Patrol helicopters that led to a federal indictment. Rose City Antifa also used A/I Collective tools and services to disseminate doxing lists and release illegally obtained personal information of Federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement, along with calls for targeted attacks on ICE agents in the streets and “in their homes.” 


However, as Torch Antifa Network

points out

, Rose City Antifa does not use A/I services and did not carry out these actions. Federal officials are instead referring to communications by Rose City Counter-Info, an entirely different group that does use A/I services. “Rose City” is a common nickname for Portland, Oregon. Not all groups that use this phrase in their name are identical. These outright falsehoods were credulously amplified by reporters at

Fox News

 and the

National Review

. 


Yet despite the incompetence this shows, designating A/I Collective as a “Specially Designated Global Terrorist” poses a very serious threat. As C4SS’s Technical Coordinator William Gillis

put it

, “This is a HUGE attack on basic free speech. Words completely fail me when addressing the potential loss to the anarchist movement of — as the US names it — 5,500 mailing lists, and 10,000 blogs.”


The State Department emphasizes users of the A/I Collective’s services that have allegedly committed crimes, including sabotage and terrorism. But many users are engaged in clearly First Amendment protected activities. These include anarchist bookfairs, antifascist researchers who study and expose far-right groups, the blog of a peer-reviewed academic journal, and an anarchist podcast and radio show. 


The “Specially Designated Global Terrorist” classification subjects Autistici/Inventati to sanctions. This means that purely based on a decree from the U.S. executive branch, anyone who engages in transactions with the A/I Collective becomes vulnerable to legal reprisal. As a result, the collective’s website has been

taken down

,

PayPal

 has blocked their account, and the Italian bank

Banca Etica

 plans to close their account. 


These sanctions have had a devastating effect on the A/I Collective. As

Sabot Media

reports

, “On September 6, eleven days after the United States placed the Italian technology collective on its terrorism sanctions list, A/I announced that the collective itself will close and that the email, blogging, hosting and communications services it has provided for a quarter century will soon be discontinued.” 


This is a chilling precedent. The executive branch can unilaterally declare that a provider of web hosting, email services, and other communications infrastructure is a “Specially Designated Global Terrorist.” By doing so, they can impose sanctions, and thereby destroy that provider. This can impose serious costs on speakers, organizers, and researchers that use the providers’ services. And …

title: DEM Parti'den silahsızlanma açıklaması: “Elimizde bir tarih yok”
content:
DEM Parti Sözcüsü Ayşegül Doğan, partisinin haftalık bilgilendirme toplantısında gündeme ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulundu. Doğan, toplantının ardından gazetecilerin sorularını da yanıtladı.

DEM Parti’nin 5’inci Olağan Büyük Kongresi sonrasında gerçekleştirilen Merkez Yürütme Kurulu (MYK) toplantısında ele alınan başlıkları aktaran Doğan, “Barış ve Demokratik Toplum Süreci” olarak ifade ettiği sürece ilişkin de açıklamalarda bulundu.

PKK’nın silah bırakma sürecine ilişkin soruları yanıtlayan Doğan, temasların ve saha çalışmalarının sürdüğünü söyledi.

Doğan, silahsızlanmaya ilişkin karşılıklı çalışmalar yürütüldüğünü ve bunun için oluşturulan mekanizmaların çalıştığını belirterek, “Önümüzdeki günlerde silahsızlanmaya dair önemli gelişmelerin olmasını bekliyoruz.” dedi.

Kamuoyuyla paylaşılabilecek somut gelişmeler ortaya çıktığında bunların açıklanacağını belirten Doğan, silahsızlanmaya ilişkin şu aşamada belirlenmiş bir tarih olmadığını ifade etti.

Doğan, “Silahsızlanmaya dair şu an elimizde bulunan bir tarih yok. Yalnızca basın toplantısında ifade ettiğim gibi tarafların açıklamaları ve sahada pratik çalışmalar var.” diye konuştu.

Dışişleri Bakanı Hakan Fidan’ın silahsızlanma sürecinde gecikme yaşandığı yönündeki açıklamalarının hatırlatılması üzerine Doğan, Fidan’ın değerlendirmesine katıldığını söyledi.

Doğan, “Gönül isterdi ki silahsızlanma açıklamanın hemen ardında yaşansaydı. Ancak biz başından beri söyledik ki yasal çerçeve hızla çıkmalı, silahsızlaşmanın takvimi geciktirilmemeli.” dedi.

Sürecin daha hızlı ilerlemesi gerektiğini belirten Doğan, silahsızlanmanın takviminin oluşturulması gerektiğini ancak bunun gerçekleşmediğini söyledi.

Doğan, gazetecilerin partisinin anayasa ve cumhurbaşkanlığı adaylığı konusundaki tutumuna ilişkin sorularını da yanıtladı.

Cumhurbaşkanlığı adaylığı konusunda parti içerisinde bir tartışma yürütülmediğini belirten Doğan, Türkiye’nin demokratik bir anayasaya ihtiyacı olduğunu söyledi.

Doğan, anayasanın hazırlanma sürecinin demokratik ve kapsayıcı olması gerektiğini belirterek, “Biz bu tartışmanın öznesiyiz. Bizim anayasa konusunda pazarlığımız yok.” ifadelerini kullandı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Ferdinand Domela Nieuwenhuis - Staten och militarismen
content:
Författare

: Ferdinand Domela Nieuwenhuis

Titel

: Staten och militarismen

Källa

: Tidningen Brand #3 1917


 Staten kan icke existera utan militarismen. De som förklara sig mot militarismen men för staten ha därför icke allvarligt nog begrundat problemet. Dessa tvenne faktorer komplettera varandra.


 Vad är egentligen staten?


 Staten är, under alla sina olika former, ett instrument till förtryck, som den besittande klassen använder sig av för att hålla de besittningslösa i fattigdom och beroende.


 Ju mer man utvidgar statens makt, desto starkare är dess förtryck. Och under den senare tiden har statens makt betydligt ökats, trots alla sociala reformer. Den börda som pressar industriarbetarna (producenterna) har blivit betydligt tyngre. Och det är på dem det hela vilar. Om man tar ett samhälle på 5,000 personer, varav 1,000 producera, så underhålla dessa 1,000 arbetare de 5,000, vilket blir en producent på fem konsumenter.


 Man beräkner att i de europeiska staterna finns femton millioner män som äta ur statens krubba. De äro icke blott parasiter, men de hålla dessutom staternas öden i sina händer.


 Till denna klass hör kungarna, ministrarna, diplomaterna och generalerna, adeln och militärbefälet, alla funktionärer, de som sitta inne med de höga platserna inom industrien etc. För dessa äro kriget, även när det leder till ett nederlag, profitabelt, såväl materiellt som socialt.


 Man säger: det är just därför, som vi måste erövra statsmaskineriet för att göra det nyttigt för de besittningslösa. Tror ni på det?


 En maskin som gjorts för ett visst ändamål, kan icke benyttas till ett fullständigt motsatt ändamål. Allt det där pratet är därför bluff! Staten är en regeringsmaskin, en maktmaskin, och förutsätter alltid ett medel med vilket man kan böja de motvilliga. Den är således ett tvångsinstrument. Kalla det vad ni vill: polis, militarism, - det är sak samma, det är alltid makten som uppträder med våld. Staten är mänsklighetens mest öppna, mest skamliga och mest kompletta negation. Den bryter människornas internationella solidaritet och ersätter den med en begränsad, nationell sammanhållning, och detta just i syfte att förstöra, att erövra och underlägga sig den övriga delen.


 Det finns icke den grymhet, den våldsgärning, det helgerån, den falskhet, det bedrägeri, den nedriga sammansvärjning, den skamliga banditism, det fräcka tjuveri, det förräderi som icke har begåtts och fortfarande dagligen begås under täckmanteln av

statens intresse

.


 Machiavelli erkände det öppet.


 Ty hur betraktade staterna alltid folken? Som en livlös massa, som en för staten avlad köttmassa, tvungen att underkasta sig och betala, bestämd till en evig lydnad.


 Därför har staten behov av militarismen. Den kan icke leva och blomstra utan den. Det är således ett oförnuftigt företag, att bekämpa resultatet, utan att röra vid orsaken.


 Människorna ha blivit utestängda från sin naturliga egendom (jorden) vare sig medelst våld eller list. Och berövade alla arbetsmedel måste de sälja sina krafter och utlämna sig på nåd och onåd till de besittande. Därav kommer slaveriet för den stora massan. Ty vad är det karaktäristiska för slaveriet? Att man

arbetar för andra.

 Nå väl, den stora massan arbetar för andra. Den befinner sig i slaveri.


 Och vem beskyddar och upprätthåller detta tillstånd?


 Staten!


 Staten tjänar således kapitalismens intresse, ty från den får den liv och tillvaro.


 Militarismen utgör en integrerande beståndsdel i staten; man kan således icke klara sig utan den.


 Läs Krapotkins bok:

Den modärna staten

. Där skall man se: "Det är alltid en livlig önskan att få avsättningsmarknad för sina produkter och strävan efter att exploatera de efterblivna folken, som är orsaken till de modärna krigen. I Europa slåss man icke längre för monarkernas ära. Man kastar den ena arméen mot den andra för att skydda de mäktiga herrarna Rotchilds och Schneiders, det mycket aktade aktiebolaget d'Anzin, eller den mycket heliga katolska bankens i Rom inkomster. Kungarna räknas icke längre. Alla krig som förts i Europa sedan hundrafemtio år tillbaka ha varit krig för handelsintressen, för rätten till exploatering." I varje stat finns det en klick, en klass av män, ännu mäktigare än fabrikanterna, som söka nya avsättningsområden, nya källor till rikedom, och som tillskynda krigen. Det är de stora finansiärerna, bankirerna, som ingripa i de internationella förhållandena och "utspy krig".

author: Sufia Khalid
title: The National Security Exception Was Never Going to Stop at Prosecuting Muslims
content:
For 25 years, the US ran a parallel legal system targeting Muslims. It now reaches activists, immigrants, and the left.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

For 25 years, the US ran a parallel legal system largely for Muslims. It now reaches immigrants and the left.

Less than two weeks after the September 11, 2001, attacks, President George W. Bush told Congress that the war on terror “begins with al Qaeda, but it does not end there.” Twenty-five years later, his line reads as a confession: the war on terror was designed to have no borders and no end, and the legal machinery built to wage it at home was drafted in the same way.

In my work as a federal criminal defense and constitutional law attorney, I defend people unjustly prosecuted by that machinery. Until recently, most of my clients were Muslim. What their cases demonstrate is that after 9/11, the United States built a separate system of justice — a national security exception to the Constitution — that was largely tested on a population that was demonized by both the state and the media. While non-Muslims were assured it would never apply to them — and were repeatedly told not to worry about the creeping encroachment of the state if they had nothing to hide — that assurance has expired.

The national security exception to the Constitution operates through a variety of mechanisms: statutes vague enough to criminalize charity and speech; informants and undercover agents who manufacture crimes they later “disrupt”; classified evidence defendants cannot see; mass surveillance; and a sentencing enhancement that categorizes even first-time, nonviolent defendants as hardened career offenders. Each element was justified as an emergency measure, but none of them has expired.

In 2004, Justice Sandra Day O’Connor wrote in Hamdi v. Rumsfeld (a Supreme Court case that found that American citizens detained from an active combat zone as enemy combatants retain the right to due process and a meaningful opportunity to challenge the factual basis of their detention before a neutral decision-maker) that “a state of war is not a blank check for the President when it comes to the rights of the Nation’s citizens.” But for Muslims in U.S. courtrooms, it has functioned as one. Sixty years earlier, dissenting in Korematsu v. United States, in which the Supreme Court upheld the internment of over 120,000 Japanese Americans during World War II, Justice Robert Jackson warned that a principle of discrimination, once blessed by the courts, “lies about like a loaded weapon, ready for the hand of any authority that can bring forward a plausible claim of an urgent need,” and that “every repetition imbeds that principle more deeply in our law and thinking and expands it to new purposes.”

We have been living inside that warning, with the guise of “national security” as the ever-prevailing “urgent need.”

The statutes criminalizing the “material support” of terrorism sit at the center of the exception. Under the U.S. federal criminal code, Section 2339B of Title 18 makes it a felony to provide “material support or resources” to any group the secretary of state designates a foreign terrorist organization, with no requirement that the defendant intended to further violence or that anything they provided was ever used for such purpose. Section 2339A criminalizes “material support” of terrorist acts, which includes property damage, for anyone — no organizational affiliation, foreign or domestic, is necessary. After 9/11, Congress added “expert advice or assistance,” to the definition of material support, extended the law to “any property, tangible or intangible, or service,” and increased the maximum sentence for Section 2339B to 20 years. In Holder v. Humanitarian Law Project, the Supreme Court held in 2010 that even teaching members of designated groups to peacefully use international law and petition the United Nations could be prosecuted as support for terrorism.

author: Sicilia Libertaria
title: Orizzonti di guerra e prospettive di lotta
content:
Corsa agli armamenti.


Orizzonti di guerra, parafrasando un celebre film, si potrebbe definire questo nostro tempo in cui i conflitti armati, agiti o minacciati, occupano lo spazio politico e mediatico e si presentano con una forza necessitante che non ammette discussioni o ripensamenti. Ma la guerra di per sé non è una novità, non è entrata in scena recentemente. La storia del XX secolo, per rimanere ad un periodo circoscritto, si è venuta svolgendo attraverso due tragicissime guerre mondiali, e anche il periodo successivo, quello della pace armata e delle armi nucleari come deterrente, ci ricordava già qualche decennio fa Eduardo Galeano in un suo straordinario libro –

A testa in giù. La scuola del mondo alla rovescia

– ha visto la morte di più di 20 milioni di persone a causa delle guerre. Dal 2001, data degli attentati alle Torri gemelle di New York, è entrata in scena la guerra permanente statunitense che si è dispiegata lungo vaste aree del pianeta contribuendo a creare quell’incertezza e quell’instabilità che appaiono i segni distintivi di questa epoca triste. Con lo scoppio del conflitto in Ucraina nel 2022 la guerra anche alle nostre latitudini è stata pienamente normalizzata, ricorrendo all’antico adagio del nemico, altro e irriducibile, da cui difendersi a tutti i costi. Così è ripartita una nuova corsa agli armamenti che vede protagonisti governi e parlamenti dei principali Stati a livello mondiale. Emblema di questa follia, come richiesto da Trump e fatto proprio da molti governi, è l’aumento del contributo alle spese della Nato fino al 5% del Pil. Corsa agli armamenti che, pur nella costanza dell’aumento delle spese militari degli ultimi decenni, si presenta oggi con una qualità differente, a causa di quella normalizzazione della guerra di cui si diceva. E così la guerra di fronte all’estrema instabilità che ci attraversa non è più un’ipotesi da scongiurare eventualmente con gli strumenti della diplomazia – che potevano “anche” fallire- ma una concreta e praticabile opzione. Una scelta legittimata già dal modo in cui vengono concepite le relazioni tra Stati e fatta diventare necessaria dalla propaganda mediatica.


Tuttavia

, oltre le particolarità di questa fase storica, le trasformazioni in atto nel sistema politico ed economico mondiale, le ragioni (o presunte tali) contingenti che hanno fatto scaturire i diversi conflitti in corso, da quello russo-ucraino, a quello in Iran, a Gaza, in Libano e ai tanti altri, persino dimenticati o poco spendibili sul piano mediatico, forse sarebbe opportuno svincolarsi dalle manifestazioni attuali della guerra, delle guerre, provando a penetrare più a fondo nelle dinamiche del sistema capitale-mondo, nelle sue perverse logiche di sopraffazione, di affarismo, e assumendo anche una posizione etica rispetto alla dominante realpolitik. Certo ci sono le famose cause delle guerre: economiche, politiche, di egemonia, culturali; a volte cause insospettate, addirittura poco convenienti da un punto di vista economico, come è avvenuto per l’imperialismo otto-novecentesco i cui risultati economici erano meno importanti della volontà d’imporsi che spingeva le potenze dell’epoca a impegnarsi in guerre dispendiose e senza senso (a proposito l’Italia ne sa qualcosa con le sue guerre coloniali, dall’Eritrea, alla Libia, alla Somalia, all’Etiopia). Figurarsi oggi se questa volontà di potenza non solletichi un Trump o un Putin! E c’è pure la geopolitica che ci spiega le relazioni tra gli Stati, come sia in corso uno scontro imperialista tra Stati Uniti e Cina, come bisognerebbe per l’Italia o l’Europa prendere parte a questa lotta e ritagliarsi uno spazio, adottando gli stessi strumenti e le stesse logiche della supremazia e del prevalere (leggere qualche numero di Limes per capire di cosa si sta parlando) e mentre ci spiega tutto questo la geopolitica ci suggerisce che oltre questo quadro dato non ci sono alternative, la realtà è questa e bisogna farci i conti.


Ma è sufficiente

 sapere di geopolitica, comprendere cause, contesti, motivazioni delle guerre, di quelle note e di quelle ignote, per far nascere forme reali, praticabili, incisive di opposizione alla guerra? Premesso che conosciamo e comprendiamo già (certo per chi vuole conoscere e comprendere) cause o origini dei conflitti del passato o del presente, il punto è che ciò non è sufficiente per spingere verso una concreta opposizione alla guerra. Anzi pare che oggi, e non solo per la guerra, più “conosciamo” e più …

author: ak-Interview: Guido Speckmann, ak 729
title: »Wir wollen das kriegsunwillige Hamburg«
content:
Tina Reiß von der Interventionistischen Linken, aktiv im Bündnis Rheinmetall Entwaffnen, über die geplanten Aktionstage in der Hansestadt Ende September.


Deutschland rüstet auf, zugleich wächst der Druck auf den Sozialstaat. Doch wie hängen Militarisierung, Sozialabbau und Klimakrise zusammen? Ein Gespräch über neuen Antimilitarismus, die alte Friedensbewegung und Proteste gegen die Kriegstüchtigkeit.


Frage: Die massive Aufrüstung ist nur eines von vielen Themen, die aus linker Perspektive hohen Handlungsdruck erzeugen. Warum engagierst du dich gerade in der antimilitaristischen Bewegung?


Tina Reiß: Ich begreife mich als radikale Linke. Und das bedeutet, keine Themenfeldpolitik zu machen, sondern einen umfassenden Begriff gesellschaftlicher Veränderung zu haben. Aufrüstung ist zurzeit ein besonders drängendes Thema, weil die Kriegslogik viele gesellschaftliche Bereiche durchdringt: Junge Leute bekommen Post von der Bundeswehr, täglich geht es um neue Rüstungsdeals und steigende Militärausgaben, während beim Sozialen gespart wird. Militarismus fördert mit seiner Logik von Sieg und Niederlage zudem autoritäre Tendenzen und Faschisierung. Militarisierung lässt sich zudem weder von den sozialen Kämpfen noch von der Klimakrise trennen. Die Ressourcen sind endlich und damit droht der Kampf um Zugriff auf Ressourcen, Rohstoffe und bewohnbare Orte immer gewalttätiger ausgetragen zu werden.


Frage: Du warst Anfang September auf dem Rheinmetall-Entwaffnen-Camp in Köln. Welche drei Dinge nimmst du von dort mit?


Erstens war das Camp mit weit über 2.000 Menschen größer und vielfältiger als in den vergangenen Jahren. Darin zeigt sich das wachsende Bedürfnis, sich mit Militarisierung und Aufrüstung auseinanderzusetzen und dagegen zu protestieren. Zweitens war die internationale Solidarität mit Menschen wichtig, die von Krieg betroffen sind oder sich dagegen auflehnen. Und drittens waren viele Aktive aus der Klimabewegung, den Sozialprotesten und der Schulstreikbewegung dabei. Auch darin zeigt sich, wie viele gesellschaftliche Bereiche die Militarisierung inzwischen berührt und dass neue Allianzen gesucht werden.


Ende September geht es weiter: Rheinmetall Entwaffnen mobilisiert gegen das Nato-Manöver Red Storm Charlie in Hamburg. Wie laufen die Vorbereitungen?


Die Vorbereitungen laufen gut. Schon in den vergangenen zwei Jahren gab es Proteste gegen das Nato-Manöver in Hamburg, auf denen wir aufbauen können. Dass Rheinmetall Entwaffnen dieses Jahr mit Köln und Hamburg gleich zwei große Aktionen organisiert, entspricht der Dringlichkeit der Situation und bietet die Chance, die antimilitaristische Bewegung zu verbreitern.


Worum geht es euch bei den Protesten in Hamburg?


Red Storm Charlie ist für uns exemplarisch, weil dort die zivil-militärische Zusammenarbeit auf der Ebene einer Großstadt geübt wird. Hamburg soll zum Logistik-Hub und Drehkreuz für einen möglichen Krieg gegen Russland auf- und ausgebaut werden. Dagegen wehren wir uns. Wir wollen nicht das kriegstüchtige, sondern das kriegsuntaugliche und kriegsunwillige Hamburg. Unser Fokus liegt dabei auf der Zusammenarbeit des Militärs mit zivilen Krankenhäusern, Rettungsdiensten, dem Arbeitsamt und Lebensmittelhändlern. Wir sehen darin eine Normalisierung des Krieges: Zivile Institutionen werden zu Akteuren einer Kriegsmobilisierung gemacht und Krieg als beherrschbares Szenario dargestellt, für das man nur genug üben müsse. Der Krieg ist aber die Katastrophe.


Warum ist Hamburg für die Nato so wichtig?


Es geht nicht nur um den Hafen. In Hamburg gibt es viel militärische Infrastruktur, etwa die Führungsakademie und die Universität der Bundeswehr. Hinzu kommt die lange Geschichte der Rüstungsproduktion in den Hamburger Werften. Über den Hafen werden außerdem Rüstungstransporte in aktuelle Kriegsregionen abgewickelt, und große Rüstungsunternehmen sind dort vertreten. Rheinmetall hat sein Engagement im Hafen zuletzt ebenfalls ausgebaut.


Früher war Antimilitarismus vor allem ein Thema der Friedensbewegung. Seit der Krim-Annexion durch Russland 2014 zeigt sich die alte Friedensbewegung in Teilen offen für eine Querfront. Wer engagiert sich heute in den antimilitaristischen Protesten?


Ich würde Konfliktlinien schon viel früher ansetzen. Nach den Anschlägen vom 11. September 2001 schwenkte ein Teil auch der radikalen Linken auf die Selbsterzählung des Westens als Zufluchtsort vor der Barbarei ein und war bereit, westliche Kriege hinzunehmen oder zu rechtfertigen …

author: Unknown
title: Donald Trump, varolan askeri hakların yenilenmesini "Grönland'da kontolü ele geçirdim" diye duyurdu
content:
ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Danimarka ve Grönland ile henüz imzalanmamış güvenlik anlaşması güncellemesini, ABD’ye Grönland’da “ne gerekiyorsa yapma” hakkı kazandıran ve hiçbir zaman sona ermeyecek bir düzenleme olarak ilan etti.


Danimarka Başbakanlığının açıklaması ise üç hükümetin anlaşmayı gelecek hafta New York’taki Birleşmiş Milletler Genel Kurulu sırasında imzalamasının beklendiğini gösteriyor. Düzenleme, imzalandıktan sonra Danimarka ve Grönland’daki parlamenter süreçlerin tamamlanmasıyla yürürlüğe girecek.


Anlaşma metni de henüz kamuoyuna açıklanmadı. Bu nedenle Trump’ın ABD’ye “güvenlik ve diğer bütün ihtiyaçlar üzerinde sürekli denetim” verildiği ve düzenlemenin Washington’a hiçbir maliyet getirmeyeceği yönündeki iddialarını doğrulayan bir metin yok. 


Trump, Truth Social hesabından yayımladığı açıklamada ABD’nin Danimarka Krallığı ve Grönland ile bir anlaşmaya girdiğini belirterek şöyle dedi:


“Bu anlaşma, Grönland’daki güvenlik ve diğer bütün ihtiyaçlar üzerinde ABD’ye sürekli denetim sağlıyor ve ABD’nin bütün kaygılarını tamamen gideriyor. ABD için hiçbir maliyeti olmayacak. ABD, Grönland’ı ve Amerika Birleşik Devletleri’ni korumak için Grönland’da gerekli olan her şeyi yapma yeteneğine sonsuza kadar sahip olacak.”


Trump ayrıca Washington’ın yazılı izni olmadan hiçbir “ABD hasmının” Grönland’da üs kuramayacağını, askeri varlık bulunduramayacağını veya hassas yatırımlar yapamayacağını ileri sürdü.


Düzenlemeyi “Sonsuz Ömürlü Anlaşma” diye adlandıran Trump, “Bunun sonu yok” dedi ve ABD’nin Grönland’ın “uygun bölgelerinde” büyük bir askeri varlık oluşturma çalışmalarına hemen başlayacağını açıkladı.


Danimarka: "Anlaşma henüz imzalanmadı"


Trump’ın “sürekli denetim” iddiasına karşılık Danimarka Başbakanlığı, anlaşmanın henüz imzalanmadığını açıkladı. Üç hükümetin düzenlemeyi gelecek hafta New York’taki Birleşmiş Milletler Genel Kurulu sırasında imzalaması bekleniyor.


Açıklamaya göre anlaşma, imzanın ardından Danimarka ve Grönland’daki gerekli parlamenter süreçler tamamlanmadan yürürlüğe girmeyecek.


Danimarka Başbakanı Mette Frederiksen, düzenlemenin Kuzey Kutup Bölgesi (Arktik) ve Kuzey Atlantik’te ortak güvenliği güçlendireceğini söyledi. Frederiksen, anlaşmanın “Danimarka Krallığı’nın egemenliğini ve toprak bütünlüğünü ve Grönland halkının kendi kaderini tayin hakkını tanıdığını” özellikle vurguladı.


Danimarka hükümeti böylece Trump’ın ABD’nin Grönland üzerinde “sürekli denetim” elde ettiği yolundaki açıklamasını doğrulamadı. Açıklamada ABD’ye herhangi bir egemenlik hakkı devredildiğine veya Grönland’ın güvenlik dışındaki bütün alanlarında söz hakkı tanındığına ilişkin bir ifade de yer almadı.


Grönland: "Anlaşma çıkarlarımızı tanıyor"


Grönland Özerk Hükümeti Başkanı Jens-Frederik Nielsen, tarafların anlaşmaya varmak üzere olmasını memnuniyetle karşıladı.


Nielsen, düzenlemenin Grönland’ın, Danimarka Krallığı’nın, ABD’nin ve Batı İttifakı’nın güvenliğini güçlendireceğini söyledi. Anlaşmanın “Grönland’ın çıkarlarını ve uluslararası işbirliğindeki yerini tanıdığını” belirten Nielsen de ABD’ye denetim veya egemenlik devrinden söz etmedi.


Dolayısıyla Trump’ın kullandığı “anlaşmaya girdik”, “sürekli denetimi aldık” ve “hemen başlayacağız” ifadeleri, tarafların açıkladığı hukuki durumu yansıtmıyor.


ABD’nin askeri varlığı II. Dünya Savaşı’na uzanıyor


Trump, “Başkanlar yüz yılı aşkın süredir Grönland’ın stratejik önemini biliyordu ancak hiçbiri bu konuda bir şey yapamadı” dedi. Oysa ABD’nin Grönland’daki askeri varlığı İkinci Dünya Savaşı’na kadar uzanıyor.


ABD ile Danimarka arasında 1941’de imzalanan savunma anlaşması, Nazi Almanyası’nın Danimarka’yı işgali sırasında ABD’nin Grönland’ın savunmasını üstlenmesine ve adada askeri tesisler kurmasına olanak verdi.


Savaş sonrasında bu düzenlemenin yerini, Danimarka’nın NATO’ya katılmasının ardından 1951’de imzalanan Grönland Savunma Anlaşması aldı. Anlaşma ABD’ye adada askeri üsler kurma, mevcut tesisleri kullanma ve askeri unsurlarını serbestçe hareket ettirme hakkı verdi.


Düzenleme 2004’te imzalanan Igaliku Anlaşması’yla güncellendi ve Grönland hükümetinin sürece katılımı güçlendirildi.


ABD halen Grönland’ın kuzeybatısındaki Pituffik Uzay Üssü’nü işletiyor. Eski adı Thule Hava Üssü olan tesis, füze erken uyarı sistemleri, uzay gözetimi ve Kuzey Amerika’nın savunması bakımından ABD ordusunun başlıca Arktik üslerinden biri.


Reuters’a göre ABD, 1951 anlaşması sayesinde Grönland’da zaten çok geniş uçuş, üslenme ve askeri erişim …

author: infolibre
title: Αντιπολεμική συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης σε Παλαιστίνη και Λίβανο, Σάββατο 19/9, 19.00, στο Σταθμό ΗΣΑΠ Μοναστηράκι
content:
Η

Συνέλευση Αλληλεγγύης με την Παλαιστινιακή Αντίσταση

, καλεί και αυτό το Σάββατο 19 Σεπτεμβρίου στις 19:00, στην πλατεία Μοναστηρακίου στην Αθήνα, όλους όσους σε όλο τον κόσμο αγωνίζονται ενάντια στον ιμπεριαλισμό και τον αποικιοκρατισμό να ενώσουν τις φωνές και τι δυνάμεις καταγγέλλοντας τη συνεργασία του ελληνικού κράτος με το γενοκτονικό κράτος του Ισραήλ, ώστενα μην

“αφήσουμε να γίνει η νέα κανονικότητα” η γενοκτονία και

ο σφαγιασμός ολόκληρων οικογενειών  σε Λίβανο, Δυτική Όχθη και

Γάζα

.


Από τη

Συνέλευση Αλληλεγγύης με την Παλαιστινιακή Αντίσταση

:


Αυτό το καλοκαίρι, ενώ τα κρουαζιερόπλοια πηγαινοέρχονται ανάμεσα στα νησιά και οι τουρίστες κατακλύζουν την πόλη και τις παραλίες, η γενοκτονία στη Γάζα, τη Δυτική Όχθη και τον Λίβανο συνεχίζεται. Οι σιωνιστές και οι υποστηρικτές τους στις ΗΠΑ και την Ευρώπη γνωρίζουν μόνο τη διαρκή επιθετικότητα· επωφελούνται από την επέκταση των θεάτρων πολέμου και έχουν οργανωθεί με σκοπό να συνεχίσουν τις επιθέσεις τους. Αυτό το βλέπουμε πρώτα απ’ όλα στην ίδια τη σιωνιστική οντότητα, όπου ολόκληρη η οικονομία στηρίζεται σε τεχνολογία που έχει αναπτυχθεί για την περαιτέρω αυτοματοποίηση του πολέμου, την παρακολούθηση ολόκληρων πληθυσμών και τη στρατιωτικοποίηση των συνόρων.


Στη Γάζα, αυτή η τεχνολογία χρησιμοποιείται καθημερινά. Από την κατάπαυση του πυρός, έχουν σκοτωθεί πάνω από 1.300 Παλαιστίνιοι, ενώ ο αριθμός των έμμεσων θανάτων από την πείνα, τις ασθένειες και την παρατεταμένη κατοχή είναι σίγουρα πολύ υψηλότερος. Τα τετρακόπτερα πυροβολούν συστηματικά πολίτες που έχουν καταφύγει σε σκηνές, ενώ οι Ισραηλινές Δυνάμεις Κατοχής (IOF) συνεχίζουν να ωθούν την «Κίτρινη Γραμμή» πιο βαθιά μέσα στη Λωρίδα της Γάζας, απειλώντας να πυροβολήσουν όποιον δεν μετακινηθεί μαζί της. Στα σημεία ελέγχου των IOF, τα είδη πρώτης ανάγκης κατασχέονται συστηματικά, με αποτέλεσμα να μην περνάει ούτε καν το πιο βασικό εφόδιο.


Στη Δυτική Όχθη, οι IOF έχουν σκοτώσει πάνω από 70 Παλαιστινίους μόνο φέτος· και έχουν φυλακίσει, με τη βοήθεια της προδοτικής Παλαιστινιακής Αρχής, εκατοντάδες άλλους. Αγόρια πυροβολούνται στους δρόμους της Τζενίν, της Ναμπλούς και της Ραμάλα. Μέσα στις φυλακές της κατοχής, οι φρικτές συνθήκες τεκμηριώνονται και βιντεοσκοπούνται από τους ίδιους τους σιωνιστές, όπως είδαμε πρόσφατα, όταν ο Μπεν Γκβίρ βιντεοσκόπησε τον εαυτό του και άλλους να εισβάλλουν στη γυναικεία φυλακή του Νταμούν. Ο βιασμός και άλλες μορφές βασανιστηρίων είναι συνηθισμένες. Οπλισμένοι έποικοι εισβάλλουν με τη βία σε εδάφη που πιστεύουν ότι τους έχουν υποσχεθεί, σκοτώνοντας Παλαιστινίους, βασανίζοντας και σκοτώνοντας ζώα, και ξεριζώνοντας ελαιόδεντρα, πολλά από τα οποία είναι παλαιότερα από την ίδια τη σιωνιστική οντότητα. Για τη Δυτική Όχθη, τη Γάζα και το Νότιο Λίβανο, δεν υπάρχει άλλο σχέδιο παρά τη πλήρη καταστροφή και τη γενοκτονία. Δεν θα σταματήσουν μέχρι να ισοπεδώσουν τη γη, ώστε να χτίσουν τις πόλεις τους πάνω στους τάφους και τα οστά εκείνων που έχουν σφαγιάσει.


Αυτό δεν πρέπει ποτέ να κανονικοποιηθεί. Δεν μπορούμε να αφήσουμε τον εαυτό μας να μουδιάσει από τη συνεχή γενοκτονία. Η ελπίδα τους είναι να χάσουμε τη θέληση να αγωνιστούμε, να αποφασίσουμε να υποχωρήσουμε στα όρια της δικής μας άνεσης και ασφάλειας, ώστε το σιωνιστικό εγχείρημα να μπορέσει να συνεχίσει το όραμά του. Για τον λόγο αυτό είναι σημαντικό να επαναλάβουμε ότι οι Παλαιστίνιοι, καθώς και οι σύμμαχοί τους σε ολόκληρη τη Δυτική Ασία, δεν είναι απλώς θύματα. Έχουν επιλέξει την αντίσταση επειδή δεν έχουν άλλη επιλογή· κατανοούν αυτό που εμείς στην Ευρώπη και στον Βόρειο Κόσμο δεν χρειάστηκε ποτέ να κατανοήσουμε – ότι η μαχητική αντιπαράθεση με τον ιμπεριαλισμό και την κατοχή είναι αναγκαιότητα.


Από τα χωράφια του Νότιου Λιβάνου, όπου τα μη επανδρωμένα αεροσκάφη της Χεζμπολά έχουν αναγκάσει τους σιωνιστές στρατιώτες να υποχωρήσουν στα καταφύγιά τους, μέχρι τα χωριά της Δυτικής Όχθης, όπου άνθρωποι όπως ο Φαρούκ Αντνάν Αλί Ραμαντάν αντιστέκονται ατρόμητα στις εισβολές των εποίκων στα εδάφη τους, μέχρι τη Γάζα, όπου ο λαός συνεχίζει να αντιστέκεται στην κατοχή και τις πολιτοφυλακές της απλώς επιβιώνοντας και προχωρώντας μπροστά, και μέχρι την Ευρώπη, όπου οι μετανάστες καταπολεμούν τα ρατσιστικά σύνορα και τις θανατηφόρες απωθήσεις – η αντίσταση είναι παντού.


Πριν από λίγες ημέρες, το ελληνικό κράτος υπέγραψε συμφωνία «άμυνας» ύψους 3 δισεκατομμυρίων ευρώ με το σιωνιστικό καθεστώς. Η κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη, η οποία προφανώς δεν έχει αρκετό αίμα στα χέρια της, θέλει να μας παρασύρει ακόμη πιο βαθιά στους …
