author: CMI Argentina
title: Piden la nulidad del archivo de la causa por el préstamo del FMI a Macri y Caputo
content:
Fueron 57 mil millones de dólares. El fiscal Agüero Iturbe cuestionó la sentencia que favoreció al expresidente y a funcionarios de su gobierno que hoy son ministros de Milei.


Por Irina Hauser


“Se impone la nulificación del fallo”, cuestionó el fiscal ante la Cámara Federal, José Agüero Iturbe, la sentencia de la Sala I de ese tribunal que archivó la semana pasada la causa por el préstamo de 57.100 millones de dólares del Fondo Monetario Internacional durante el gobierno de Mauricio Macri por considerar que no se había identificado ningún delito. Su objetivo es que ahora la Cámara de Casación Penal reabra el expediente cerrado por decisión de los camaristas Mariano Llorens y Pablo Bertuzzi. Además de Macri, estuvieron imputados funcionarios compartidos por la gestión macrista y la actual, como el ministro de Economía Luis Caputo, el de Desregulación, Federico Sturzenegger, y el titular del Banco Central, Santiago Bausili.


Decisión “arbitraria”


La presentación de Agüero Iturbe es un fuerte respaldo a la investigación que había hecho en primera instancia el fiscal Franco Picardi, donde señaló un abanico de irregularidades en la toma de deuda y su aprobación, y planteó dudas sobre el destino de los fondos, que no se habrían utilizado para los fines establecidos, sino para obtener divisas para su posterior fuga. Pese al caudal de pruebas acumuladas desde 2018, en febrero último la jueza María Eugenia Capuchetti dijo que no había delitos probados y que el tema en análisis podría encuadrar en aquellos considerados no judiciales. Algo similar replicaron la semana pasada los camaristas, menos de 24 horas después de la jura de Bertuzzi y de Pablo Yadarola (aunque este último se tomó licencia y no firmó).


El fiscal de Cámara dijo que el fallo del tribunal tiene “un defecto grave de motivación” y utiliza “una fundamentación aparente que resulta equiparable a su total ausencia”. Sostuvo que, además de infundado, es arbitrario y que ni siquiera propició la continuidad de una investigación, si es que se requerían más pruebas, para cumplir –además– con los lineamientos del nuevo código acusatorio, donde supone que los fiscales tienen un mayor protagonismo en la investigación.


“La finalidad de la instrucción es comprobar si existe un hecho delictuoso mediante las diligencias conducentes al descubrimiento de la verdad, objetivo que no ha de cumplirse con el temperamento adoptado, cercenando la posibilidad de efectuar cualquier medida de prueba en ese sentido”, dice el dictamen, al que accedió Página/12. “Los señores jueces arbitrariamente desestimaron el cauce investigativo propuesto por la fiscalía”, que “debe profundizarse y, hasta que ello ocurra, cualquier decisión aparece como prematura y por tanto sin fundamento”, advirtió.


“En estas actuaciones se investiga un esquema defraudatorio planeado, coordinado y desarrollado -entre mayo del 2018 y septiembre del 2019- por funcionarios públicos del Poder Ejecutivo y el Banco Central, en conjunto con agentes del sector privado, que se configuró contrayendo una deuda estatal insostenible, a sabiendas de que resultaría imposible su repago, por la suma de 57.100 millones de dólares, vulnerando la Constitución Nacional y las leyes nacionales y normas que regulan el funcionamiento de la administración pública nacional y la toma de crédito público”, recordó.


La revisión estará a cargo de la Sala IV de la Cámara Federal de Casación Penal, que integran Mariano Borinsky, Gustavo Hornos y Javier Carbajo. Se trata de una causa que, además de unir a los mundos macrista y libertario, sintetiza un sendero económico.


Claves del caso


La Cámara llegó a decir cosas tales como que, si se habían violado procedimientos administrativos para tomar la deuda millonaria, eso no necesariamente era una conducta delictiva, por más que haya afectado al erario público. Lo planteó en línea con Capuchetti, a quien el fiscal Picardi cuestionó por no haber hecho un análisis integral y con contexto de todas las evidencias, lo que desnaturalizaba y “desmembraba” una investigación compleja en un caso que hacía imprescindible analizar incluso los roles de los exfuncionarios.


La investigación de Picardi había concluido que no se respetaron los procedimientos previos y rigurosos para tomar deuda pública de modo “responsable, razonable y legal”. Por acción u omisión se incumplieron esas normas de Hacienda, Finanzas y del Banco Central. Por ejemplo, el entonces ministro de Hacienda, Nicolás Dujovne, firmó …

author: infolibre
title: Ο Δήμος Θεσσαλονίκης ξεπλένει την «Ελληνικός Χρυσός»
content:
Αντιδράσεις προκαλεί η συνεργασία του Δήμου Θεσσαλονίκης με την Ελληνικός Χρυσός για τη δωρεάν διάθεση δενδρυλλίων στους δημότες. Η δημοτική αρχή κατηγορείται ότι μέσω της συγκεκριμένης χορηγίας συμβάλλει στο «πράσινο ξέπλυμα» της εταιρείας, με φόντο τις περιβαλλοντικές επιπτώσεις της εξορυκτικής δραστηριότητας στη ΒΑ Χαλκιδική. Ζητείται η άμεση διακοπή της συνεργασίας και η συζήτηση του θέματος στο Δημοτικό Συμβούλιο.


Σύμφωνα με ανακοίνωσή του, ο Δήμος Θεσσαλονίκης καλεί τους δημότες να πάρουν δωρεάν από τον ίδιο και να φυτέψουν δενδρύλλια σε ιδιωτικούς χώρους. Σε μια πόλη που πάσχει από τραγική έλλειψη πράσινου και δημόσιων χώρων, θα ήταν μια αξιέπαινη πρωτοβουλία, αν από πίσω δεν κρυβόταν ένα από τα μεγαλύτερα περιβαλλοντικά -και οικονομικά- εγκλήματα στη Βόρεια Ελλάδα.


Ο χορηγός των δενδρυλλίων είναι η περίφημη Ελληνικός Χρυσός, θυγατρική της καναδικής Eldorado Gold, η εταιρεία που είναι υπεύθυνη για τεράστιες περιβαλλοντικές καταστροφές στις Σκουριές και όλη τη ΒΑ Χαλκιδική: πέντε χιλιάδες στρέμματα αποψιλωμένου δάσους, κατεστραμμένοι υδάτινοι πόροι, διαρροές επικίνδυνων αποβλήτων. Και δίπλα στην περιβαλλοντική, η οικονομική καταστροφή: η παραγωγική βάση της περιοχής διαλύεται, οι μελισσοκόμοι και οι γεωργοί αποχωρούν και τη θέση τους παίρνουν μεταφερμένοι, κακοπληρωμένοι εργάτες. Και όλα αυτά μέσω μιας αποικιοκρατικής σύμβασης, όπου -ως συνήθως- το ελληνικό δημόσιο χρεώνεται, ώστε να κερδοσκοπούν οι ιδιώτες.


Δεν χρειάζεται να πούμε περισσότερα, αφού η πόλη θυμάται: εδώ και δυο δεκαετίες, η επένδυση της Eldorado προκάλεσε το μεγαλύτερο ίσως περιβαλλοντικό κίνημα στη χώρα. Δεκάδες χιλιάδες Θεσσαλονικείς έχουν συμμετάσχει στις μεγάλες διαδηλώσεις και συναυλίες, έχουν πάει στις Σκουριές, έχουν έρθει αντιμέτωποι με κρατική και ιδιωτική καταστολή. Γι’ αυτό ακριβώς, η Ελληνικός Χρυσός επιχειρεί συνέχεια να χτίσει ένα -πλαστό- πράσινο προφίλ: από τη μία σέρνει στα δικαστήρια όποιον δημοσιογράφο τολμήσει να αποκαλύψει τα εγκλήματά της, και από την άλλη ταΐζει συστηματικά ΜΜΕ και σκορπά χρήματα σε «πράσινες χορηγίες».


Για μια ακόμα φορά, η διοίκηση Αγγελούδη διαλέγει την ίδια πλευρά της ιστορίας: με τα συμφέροντα, απέναντι στην κοινωνία. Για λίγες χιλιάδες ευρώ που θα στοιχίσουν τα δενδρύλλια, συμβάλει ενεργά στο πράσινο ξέπλυμα της εταιρείας. Είναι γνωστό ότι η πολιτική χορηγιών της διοίκησης Αγγελούδη δεν έχει κανένα όριο, κανένα ηθικό πλαίσιο. Έχουμε επισημάνει πολλές φορές ότι όλοι οι σοβαροί οργανισμοί στον κόσμο που δέχονται χορηγίες, αναγνωρίζουν ότι αυτές προκαλούν εξαρτήσεις και έχουν τουλάχιστον μια σχετική πολιτική και ηθική, η οποία οριοθετεί το ποιος μπορεί να χορηγεί τι: δεν μπορείς για παράδειγμα να πάρεις χορηγία από μια πετρελαιοβιομηχανία για πρόγραμμα περιβαλλοντικής εκπαίδευσης. Ε, εδώ γίνεται κάτι πολύ χειρότερο.


Απαιτούμε από τη διοίκηση του Δήμου να σταματήσει τώρα αυτή τη ντροπιαστική συνεργασία, για την οποία δεν υπήρξε καν απόφαση Δημοτικού Συμβουλίου. Επιφυλασσόμαστε να θέσουμε εμείς το θέμα στο Δημοτικό Συμβούλιο της ερχόμενης Δευτέρας και καλούμε όσους και όσες αγωνίζονται εδώ και δυο δεκαετίες ενάντια στην Ελντοράντο να διαμαρτυρηθούν με κάθε δόκιμο τρόπο, μέσα κι έξω από το ΔΣ.


Και αν φυσικά η διοίκηση επιμείνει, κάνουμε δημόσια έκκληση στους δημότες και τις δημότισσες της πόλης μας, να μην γίνουν συνεργοί σε αυτή την επιχείρηση πράσινου ξεπλύματος: το δενδρύλλιο, αξίας λίγων ευρώ, που θα πάρουν «δωρεάν» από την Ελντοράντο, αντιστοιχεί σε χιλιάδες δέντρα που έχουν κοπεί, σε χιλιάδες τόνους ρύπων που έχουν επιβαρύνει την περιοχή μας, σε μια πηγή που στέρεψε, σε έναν παραγωγό που έχασε τη γη και τη δουλειά του.


Η Πόλη Ανάποδα

Ο Δήμος Θεσσαλονίκης ξεπλένει την «Ελληνικός Χρυσός»

infolibre

.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Tierra del Fuego: gran triunfo en la huelga docente del SUTEF
content:
Tras 46 días de paro por tiempo indeterminado, el gremio docente comunicó, tras la realización de un congreso provincial de 170 delegadas y delegados, que llegó a un acuerdo que incluye aumento salarial y el reconocimiento por parte del Gobierno Provincial del pago del Salario Mínimo Vital y Móvil (SMVyM) según su definición constitucional y legal para la docencia, entre otros puntos.


Horacio Catena


El Sindicato Unificado de Trabajadoras y Trabajadores de la Educación Fueguina (SUTEF) informó que la docencia resolvió la aceptación por mayoría del acuerdo discutido con los funcionarios provinciales el pasado 14 de septiembre.


La aceptación se resolvió con dos días de consultas en las instituciones educativas y un congreso provincial de delegados realizado el 17 de septiembre, donde participaron más de 170 delegadas y delegados. Allí, sobre un total de 220 mandatos, el resultado fue del 69% por la aceptación, el 29,5% por el rechazo y el 1,5% de empate.

Informe del acuerdo publicado por el SUTEF


Al finalizar el congreso, y desde el acampe frente a la Casa de Gobierno, el Secretario General del SUTEF, Horacio Catena, realizó una transmisión en vivo para informar los resultados a toda la docencia y a la comunidad.


Catena valoró la masiva participación y el nivel de conciencia demostrado por la docencia en los 46 días de paro por tiempo indeterminado, con movilizaciones y acampes en las tres ciudades de la provincia. “Para nosotros es el inicio, no es el final”, aseveró, afirmando que “en un contexto nacional de recorte, en un contexto nacional de ajuste, en un contexto nacional y provincial de pérdida de empleo, la docencia de Tierra del Fuego no va a perder ni una hora ni un cargo y esa es la mejor base para la pelea del salario mínimo, vital y móvil”.


En ese sentido, remarcó que se logró el reconocimiento por parte del Gobierno Provincial al pago del Salario Mínimo, Vital y Móvil (SMVyM) para la docencia, por lo que se constituirá una comisión técnica para establecer su monto, mecanismos de actualización y seguimiento; al respecto, explicó que, si bien se venía utilizando el valor calculado científicamente por el Frente de Sindicatos Unidos (FreSU), “ahora vamos a construir el nuestro”.


Asimismo, destacó la importancia de la lucha que arrancó el compromiso del Ejecutivo de decretar la emergencia del salario docente, planteando la necesidad de que “rápidamente el Gobierno de la Provincia saque el decreto que se compromete en el acta”.


“Acá se ha declarado la emergencia hídrica, la emergencia agropecuaria, la emergencia comercial, la emergencia forestal, la emergencia industrial; jamás en la historia de la provincia -y no quiero exagerar, pero en la historia del movimiento obrero- se ha declarado la emergencia salarial. Lo que ha logrado la docencia fueguina en total soledad política y gremial, porque la solidaridad gremial vino de afuera”, manifestó.


Horacio Catena y Rodolfo Aguiar en la marcha docente en Tierra del Fuego el 2 de septiembre. Foto: Prensa SUTEF


Respecto al respaldo y la solidaridad de clase recibida durante las siete semanas de huelga, puso en relieve el acompañamiento del FreNDEP (Frente Nacional Democrático por la Educación Pública), el FreSU y las distintas corrientes de La Multicolor, entre otros, manifestando que están agradecidos “infinitamente” tras haber dado una “pelea en soledad” en la provincia que logró “instalar un tema incómodo para la dirigencia política y para gran parte de la dirigencia sindical, que es el salario de pobreza”.


Con relación a la Ley de Financiamiento Educativo, afirmó que se realizará un seguimiento para garantizar que se sancione y que los recursos lleguen efectivamente a educación pública. “Vamos a ser custodios de que esa ley de financiamiento educativo se sancione y se empiece a recaudar, y que los fondos vayan donde tienen que ir”, sentenció, marcando como un objetivo innegociable que “el 50% de lo que se recaude sea para salarios y …

author: Randi Beers
title: News quiz Sept. 19 | Dirt, gold and deep pockets
content:
Now that the days are shorter and a bit colder, you have more time to read the news, right? Let’s go!


1. Nunavut leaders were hobnobbing in Toronto this week. Why?


A. The Nunavut Trade Show changed venue this year in order to make it easier for southern firms to learn more about investment opportunities across the territory.


B. They were in Toronto as part of Prime Minister Mark Carney’s Canada Investment Summit, which brought together private firms from across the globe to tour national infrastructure projects that need financial backing.


C. Premier John Main was invited to throw the first pitch at Tuesday’s Blue Jays game against the Detroit Tigers. Main invited NTI vice-president Paul Irngaut and Crown-Indigenous Relations Minister Rebecca Alty along, so they could discuss shared priorities while the Jays lost 10-1.


2. What appeared in a Gjoa Haven neighbourhood last week, much to the chagrin of local residents?


A. A polar bear


B. A sinkhole


C. A stinky pile of dirt


3. Actor Natar Ungalaq spoke to Nunatsiaq News last week about his life and career as his breakout movie

Atanarjuat: The Fast Runner

 turned 25 this year. Ungalaq said he saw his first movie in Igloolik, at age 4, from inside the hood of his mother’s amauti. How much did a movie ticket cost in Igloolik when Ungalaq was a child?


A. 10 cents


B. 25 cents


C. 50 cents


4. Two hopefuls are vying for an empty Hudson Bay seat in Nunavut’s legislature: Jason Iqaluq and Nukaja Sala. What do they both agree is one major need for the riding?


A. Housing


B. Lower food costs


C. Better elder care


5. If you read this week’s Taissumani, you’ll know that U.S. President Donald Trump’s grandfather Frederick Trump got rich doing what in the Yukon during the Klondike Gold Rush?


A. Searching for gold, of course.


B. Running a brothel for those panning for gold.


C. Guiding prospectors up the Chilkoot Trail.


Movie star Natar Ungalaq, left, flashes his signature smile beside lifelong friend and collaborator Zacharias Kunuk in Iqaluit’s Astro Theatre in September 2025. They attended the screening of Kunuk’s film “Uiksaringitara (Wrong Husband)”, for which Ungalaq served as acting coach. (Photo by Daron Letts)


Answers:


1. B — Proponents of the Grays Bay Road and Port Project, Iqaluit’s hydro project, the Kivalliq hydro-fibre line and others

made an appearance

 at the Canada Investment Summit in the hopes they could drum up interest in their work. Nunavut Tunngavik Inc. and the Government of Nunavut hosted an event Monday to help whet the appetites of those with deep pockets.


2. C — A

pile of soil

 that residents say stank of diesel appeared in a Gjoa Haven neighbourhood last week. Some say it was contaminated debris from a 2022 fire in the hamlet. Others say it came from a parking lot. The pile has since been removed and the hamlet is investigating.


3. B — Movie tickets were 25 cents apiece when actor Natar Ungalaq was a child in Igloolik, he

recalled

. One could buy two tickets and some popcorn for three quarters.


4. A — Both Hudson Bay MLA candidates

list housing

 as their number-one priority. Jason Iqaluq also wants to see better health-care options and more food security, while Nukaja Sala lists better elder care and a women’s shelter among her priorities. The byelection is scheduled for Sept. 28.


5. B — Frederick Trump

opened the Arctic Restaurant

 in Whitehorse. It offered booze, gambling and “sporting ladies” until the North-West Mounted Police cracked down on these activities. He eventually took his Yukon earnings back to New York City, where he began to invest in real estate. And the rest, as they say, is history.

title: Narin Güran’ın babası Ankara’ya ‘adalet yürüyüşü’ başlattı
content:
Diyarbakır’ın Bağlar ilçesinde 2024’te kaybolduktan 19 gün sonra bedeni bulunan Narin Güran’ın babası Arif Güran, olayın yeniden ele alınması talebiyle Ankara’ya ‘adalet yürüyüşü’ başlattı.


Mezopotamya Ajansı

’nın haberine göre, Arif Güran, yürüyüş öncesinde Narin Güran’ın mezarının bulunduğu Bağlar ilçesine bağlı Tavşantepe (Çulî) Mahallesi’nde açıklama yaptı.


Ailenin avukatı Onur Akdağ da burada yaptığı konuşmada, iki yıldır sürdürdükleri hukuk mücadelesinde soruşturma ve kovuşturma aşamalarına ilişkin çeşitli itirazlarda bulunduklarını anlattı.


NARİN: ÇAĞIN KARANLIK YÜZÜ - 1


Birinci yıl sona ererken Narin Davası


14 Temmuz 2025


Akdağ: Teknik veriler dikkate alınmadı


Akdağ, soruşturmanın başında DARA-2 askeri üssüne ait kamera görüntülerinin ve Salim Güran’ın telefonundaki ses kayıtlarının silindiğini, Nevzat Bahtiyar’ın telefonunun ise kollukta sıfırlanmaya çalışıldığını ileri sürdü.


Kovuşturma aşamasında WhatsApp raporunun sahte olduğunun ortaya çıktığını savunan Akdağ, daraltılmış baz raporunun da ses, görüntü ve diğer dijital verilerle çeliştiğini söyledi.


ADALETİN EKSİK KALDIĞI BİR ÇOCUK CİNAYETİ


Narin’e hepimizin hakikat borcu var


21 Ağustos 2025


Akdağ, Ulusal Kriminal Büro’nun görüntülere ilişkin değerlendirmesine de itiraz ederek, ABD’de iyileştirdikleri görüntülerin Narin Güran’ın eve ulaşmadığını gösterdiğini öne sürdü. Görüntülerde, patikanın başındaki bir kişinin Narin’i Nevzat Bahtiyar’ın ahırının bulunduğu yöne götürdüğünü düşündüklerini ve buna ilişkin raporu mahkemeye sunduklarını söyledi.


Salim Güran’ın telefon kayıtlarına ilişkin hazırlattıkları rapora da değinen Akdağ, daraltılmış baz raporundaki tespitlerin aksine Güran’ın olay sırasında evinde olduğuna işaret eden veriler bulunduğunu savundu.


Akdağ, mahkemelerin bu verileri dikkate almadığını ileri sürerek yeniden yargılama talebinde bulunduklarını söyledi.


Narin Güran dosyası için Meclis araştırması önergesi


20 Ağustos 2026


“Yeniden yargılanma istiyorum”


Arif Güran ise iki yıldır hukuk mücadelesi verdiklerini belirterek yürüyüşün amacının kızının ölümüne ilişkin “hakikatin ortaya çıkması” olduğunu söyledi.


“Bu yola çıkmamın tek sebebi kızımın hakkıdır, hakikatidir” diyen Güran, Ankara’ya kadar yürümeyi ve Cumhurbaşkanlığı Külliyesi’nin önüne gitmeyi planladığını anlattı.


Narin Güran davasında yeniden inceleme çağrısı


13 Temmuz 2026


Güran, Cumhurbaşkanı ve AKP Genel Başkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’a seslendi:


Buradan çıkışımın, Ankara’da varışımın yeri külliyenin önü olacaktır. Narin için hakikat, Narin için adalet sloganımdır.


Yürüyüşten vazgeçmeyeceğini söyleyen Güran, “Bir ay da sürse iki ay da sürse ne olursa olsun bu yolda devam edeceğim” dedi.


Güran sözlerini, “Yeniden yargılanma istiyorum” diyerek tamamladı.


Açıklamanın ardından kent çıkışına geçen Güran, Ankara’ya doğru yürüyüşüne başladı.


Ne olmuştu?


Narin Güran, 21 Ağustos 2024’te Diyarbakır’ın Bağlar ilçesine bağlı Tavşantepe Mahallesi’nde kayboldu. Sekiz yaşındaki Güran’ın bedeni, 19 gün süren arama çalışmalarının ardından 8 Eylül’de Eğertutmaz Deresi’nde, bir çuval içinde ve taşlarla üzeri kapatılmış halde bulundu.


Soruşturmanın ardından Narin’in annesi Yüksel Güran, ağabeyi Enes Güran, amcası Salim Güran ve komşuları Nevzat Bahtiyar hakkında dava açıldı. Diyarbakır 8. Ağır Ceza Mahkemesi, 28 Aralık 2024’te Yüksel, Enes ve Salim Güran’a “iştirak halinde çocuğa karşı kasten öldürme” suçundan ayrı ayrı ağırlaştırılmış müebbet hapis cezası verdi. Mahkeme, Nevzat Bahtiyar’ı ise “suç delillerini yok etme, gizleme veya değiştirme” suçundan 4 yıl 6 ay hapis cezasına çarptırdı. 


Yargıtay 1. Ceza Dairesi, Aralık 2025’te Yüksel, Enes ve Salim Güran hakkındaki ağırlaştırılmış müebbet hapis cezalarını onadı. Bahtiyar hakkındaki kararı ise eyleminin “nitelikli kasten öldürmeye yardım” kapsamında değerlendirilmesi gerektiği gerekçesiyle bozdu.


Bozma kararının ardından yeniden yargılanan Bahtiyar’a Diyarbakır 8. Ağır Ceza Mahkemesi, 16 Nisan 2026’da “nitelikli olarak çocuğu kasten öldürmeye yardım” suçundan 17 yıl hapis cezası verdi.


Güran ailesi ve avukatları ise soruşturma ve yargılama sürecinde bazı dijital verilerin ve diğer delillerin yeterince değerlendirilmediğini savunuyor. Aile, dosyanın yeniden ele alınmasını ve yeniden yargılama yapılmasını istiyor. Temmuz 2026’da “Narin ve Ailesi İçin Adalet Platformu” da dosyanın bütün yönleriyle yeniden incelenmesi çağrısı yaptı. 


(VC)

title: FEDA in Geneva: Alevi demands must be part of the peace process
content:
In Geneva, the Democratic Alevi Federation (FEDA) has launched a two-day vigil in support of the process for peace and a democratic society. The organization is combining its support for the process with concrete demands for equality, constitutional recognition, and accountability for Turkish state policies targeting Alevis.


Alongside Alevi organizations, revolutionary, democratic, and civil society groups are also taking part in the action. A tent set up on Friday is hosting discussions on the peace process and meetings with various institutions. The action is scheduled to conclude today with a joint rally in front of the United Nations headquarters.


The Geneva vigil is part of a series of activities held in September in cities including Zurich, Strasbourg, St. Gallen, Leverkusen, Dortmund, and Paris. As part of these activities, the participating organizations held talks and visited various institutions.


“No free and equal society without peace”


Songül Aslan, co-spokesperson of FEDA Switzerland, described the process initiated by Abdullah Öcalan as a historic opportunity to end the decades-long conflict in Turkey and establish lasting peace. “As Reya Heq Alevis, we support this process and embrace it as our own. Without peace, an equal and free life and a democratic society are not possible,” Aslan said.


At the same time, she stressed that society’s diversity must be reflected in any future democratic order: “We want the demands of Alevis to be taken into account in a constitution created for a democratic society based on lasting peace.”


Demand for constitutional recognition


FEDA pointed to a history spanning roughly a century of denial, assimilation, and unequal treatment of the Alevi population, saying that the process must therefore also lead to constitutional guarantees for religious and identity rights. Key demands include guaranteeing equal citizenship and recognizing Alevism as a distinct faith. FEDA also calls for the abolition of compulsory religious education and the dissolution of the state-run authority for Alevi-Bektashi culture and cemevis.


FEDA further demands that the state religious authority, Diyanet, either be abolished or restructured so that it serves all faith communities on an equal basis. Other demands include the return of sacred sites and material assets confiscated under the law on dervish orders and lodges, as well as the establishment of a legal framework allowing religious services to be conducted in people’s respective mother tongues.


Call for accountability for massacres


Another key focus is addressing the past. FEDA is calling for state archives to be opened, an official apology for massacres against Alevis, and the fulfillment of the resulting legal obligations. The organization also demands the restoration of original place names. In addition, it calls for an amendment to the Village Law, which defines a village, among other criteria, by the presence of a mosque in its center.


“The process for peace and a democratic society must ultimately lead to a system in which all communities and faith groups can live freely and as equals. No identity or faith should be placed above another,” FEDA stated. The goal, it said, must be a democratic social contract and a new constitution that guarantees equality among communities, faith groups, and identities.


The statement concludes with the words: “Where there is understanding, there is peace. Where there is peace, there is coexistence. Love is our religion, peace is our worship.”

title: Şebnem Korur Fincancı: The course of the process depends on the conditions on Imrali
content:
What does it take to turn the end of armed conflict into lasting peace? For human rights defender and forensic medicine expert Prof. Dr. Şebnem Korur Fincancı, the answer lies not merely in the silencing of weapons. Democratization, guarantees of fundamental rights, truth and justice, and the active participation of society are indispensable.


In an interview with ANF, Fincancı discusses the conditions necessary for effective negotiations, Abdullah Öcalan’s conditions on Imrali, and the consequences of decades of conflict for public health. She argues that negotiations do not mean the end of the struggle for rights; rather, they must create the space for democratic politics and social participation to replace violence.


From a human rights perspective, what specific criteria must a “genuine and dignified peace” be based on?


First of all, we must not define peace solely as the silencing of weapons. It is, of course, extraordinarily important that people are no longer dying and that the conflict comes to an end. But that is the beginning of peace, not peace itself.


The foundation of genuine and dignified peace is human dignity, equal citizenship, the protection of rights, and people’s ability to have a say in decisions affecting their own lives. What is needed is a social order in which people can express their identity, language, and thoughts without fear; in which the right to vote and to stand for election is genuinely guaranteed; and in which the law is not applied differently depending on a person’s identity or political affiliation.


Another important dimension is truth and justice. If serious human rights violations have occurred in the past, lasting peace cannot be achieved by sweeping them under the rug. The truth about enforced disappearances, the suffering endured, forced displacement, torture, and other serious human rights violations must be confronted. Saying, “Let us forget the past now,” without mechanisms for accountability and reparation does not create peace.


A dignified peace therefore means ensuring that the absence of conflict, truth, justice, equality, freedom, and social participation are achieved together.


Democracy as the foundation of peace


You say that we should not reduce “peace” to the absence of conflict. Why is democratization so important to this process?


If we understand peace merely as the end of conflict, that is too narrow a perspective. What matters is creating democratic conditions for people to live together. Unless the rule of law, equal citizenship, freedom of expression, and justice are strengthened, it will also be difficult to establish peace firmly within society.


We need to build a shared future in which it is recognized that every person’s dignity has equal value, without weighing the suffering endured by different groups in the past against one another. Because genuine peace does not simply mean that the weapons fall silent. It means a society in which people can live without fear of one another, where their rights are guaranteed, and where they can make their voices heard through democratic means. Society itself is the true agent of peace.


Democratization is not a secondary component of this process; it is its foundation. If the weapons are merely silenced without addressing the underlying causes of the conflict, the problem remains unresolved. As long as demands for equal citizenship, freedom of expression and association, political representation, and legal certainty are not met, social tensions will continue to persist in other forms.


Peace and democracy are two processes that complement one another. If peace is discussed on the one hand while democratic space is restricted on the other, society cannot develop trust in the process. Democracy is the guarantee of peace. And one of the most important measures of democracy is whether social problems can be resolved through politics and law rather than through violence.


Negotiations require continuity


There has so far been no concrete progress regarding the status of Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan. What significance does this have for the healthy progress of the process?


This issue should not be viewed in terms of privileges for individuals, but rather in terms of the conditions necessary for an effective negotiation process. If a person plays a decisive role in a negotiation process, the necessary conditions for communication, dialogue, and work must also be in place to enable them to fulfill …

title: Trump Says He’s Banning CNN, MS NOW, and Politico From the White House
content:
“These outrageous attacks only demonstrate how scared he is of an informed public,” said one press freedom advocate.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

In one of his most direct assaults on the First Amendment, President Donald Trump announced in a Friday afternoon tirade that he would ban CNN, MS NOW (formerly MSNBC), and Politico from the White House.

“I am proud to announce that, effective immediately, I am banning Fake News CNN, MSNOW … and Politico from the White House as a result of their constant ‘reporting’ FAKE NEWS!” the president wrote in a rambling Truth Social post.

“Media Outlets shouldn’t be able to constantly write or report FICTION and LIES when they’re covering the President of the United States, the Trump Administration, or the United States of America,” he added, though he did not specify any particular reports he objected to. He added that bans on “Other Fake News Media Outlets” would soon follow.

Trump announces he is banning CNN, MSNOW, and Politico from the White House in a blatant violation of the First Amendment of the US Constitution. https://t.co/W0qSqpO2HU

Trump, who has long portrayed himself as a defender of free speech, has taken unprecedented actions to censor news outlets during his second term, including threatening networks’ broadcast licenses through the Federal Communications Commission over unfavorable programming.

As of Friday afternoon, it’s unclear whether Trump actually plans to follow through on his White House ban.

Reacting to the news on the air, CNN anchor Brian Stelter said that the network’s reporting team “remains at the White House working just like a usual normal Friday afternoon.” He added that “right now, there is no indication that the administration is taking any steps to actually follow through on his threat.”

“Certainly, if there is an attempt to remove journalists from the White House, well, our cameras are rolling. I think viewers will see it happen,” he said.

“CNN stands fully behind our White House team and their fair and accurate reporting,” the network said in a statement following news of the ban. “We have a right under the US Constitution to do that reporting without hindrance or interference from the government.”

Stelter: CNN’s team remains at the White House working just like a usual normal Friday afternoon. Right now, there is no indication that the administration is taking any steps to actually follow through on his threat. https://t.co/HfWAVkveuC

Bruce D. Brown, the president of the Reporters Committee for Freedom of the Press, told Common Dreams in an email Friday that simply banning news organizations from the White House over the content of their reporting “would be flatly unconstitutional.”

“The First Amendment is clear that once the White House invites in some journalists, it can’t ban others because it doesn’t like their reporting,” he said. “This is textbook viewpoint discrimination and will be quickly struck down by the courts if challenged.”

Federal courts have previously struck down attempts by Trump to bar certain press outlets on First Amendment grounds. Last year, a judge ruled that Trump’s removal of the Associated Press from the White House press pool for its refusal to adopt the name “Gulf of America” for the Gulf of Mexico was an unconstitutional form of viewpoint discrimination.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s rule banning reporters from obtaining information not authorized by the Pentagon, which led dozens of journalists to turn over their press badges and walk out of the building in protest, was also struck down as a violation of press freedom.

In light of these previous failures, Jameel Jaffer, the executive director of the Knight First Amendment Institute at Columbia University, expressed bewilderment that Trump was once again trying to ban news outlets from the White House.

“With so many courts having ruled against him on exactly this point, you’d think President Trump would have learned this lesson by now,” he said in a statement.

Seth Stern, chief of advocacy at the Freedom of the Press Foundation, agreed it was “difficult to imagine a more blatant violation of the First Amendment than Trump banning news outlets from the People’s House for criticizing the government.”

title: Cumartesi Anneleri/İnsanları: Cemil Kırbayır'ı kaybedenler neden korunuyor?
content:
Cumartesi Anneleri/İnsanları, zorla kaybedilen yakınlarının akıbetini sormak ve sorumluların yargılanmasını talep etmek için 1121. hafta buluşmasında Galatasaray Meydanı’nda bir araya geldi.


Kayıp yakınları ve hak savunucuları, bu haftaki buluşmada 13 Eylül 1980’de gözaltında kaybedilen Cemil Kırbayır’ın akıbetini sordu. Cumartesi Anneleri/İnsanları adına açıklamayı İkbal Eren okudu.


Eren, gözaltında kaybetme dosyalarında etkili soruşturma yürütülmemesinin ardından zamanaşımının gerekçe gösterilerek dosyaların kapatılmasına tepki gösterdi.


Eğer gözaltında kayıp dosyalarında olduğu gibi etkin soruşturmalar yapılmaz, tanıklar dinlenmez, deliller toplanmaz, sorumlular hesap vermeden yıllar geçirilir ve ardından “zamanaşımı doldu” denilerek dosyalar kapatılırsa, burada yalnızca bir hukuk kuralının uygulanmasından söz edilemez. Bu durum, zamanaşımı kurumunun devletin yıllarca yerine getirmediği soruşturma yükümlülüğünün üzerini örten bir kalkan haline getirilmesidir.

–Cumartesi Anneleri/İnsanları 1121. hafta açıklamasından


Cemil Kırbayır’a ne oldu?


Cumartesi Anneleri/İnsanları’nın açıklamasına göre 26 yaşındaki Kars Eğitim Enstitüsü öğrencisi Cemil Kırbayır, 13 Eylül 1980’de Ardahan’ın Göle ilçesine bağlı Okçu köyündeki evinden güvenlik güçleri tarafından gözaltına alındı.


Önce Göle’deki 247. Piyade Alayı’na götürülen Kırbayır, yaklaşık bir hafta burada tutuldu. Ardından Kars Emniyet Müdürlüğü’ne, daha sonra da gözetimevi olarak kullanılan Kars Eğitim Enstitüsü’ne götürüldü.


Ailesi, Kırbayır’ı görebilmek ve ihtiyaçlarını karşılamak için gözaltında tutulduğu merkezlere gidip geldi. Ancak aile, 8 Ekim’den sonra kendilerine “Oğlunuz firar etti, bir daha onu sormaya gelmeyin” denildiğini ve o tarihten sonra Kırbayır’dan haber alamadıklarını anlattı.


Ailenin ve Türkiye Barolar Birliği’nin yaptığı suç duyurularından sonuç alınmadı.


Kırbayır’ın annesi Berfo Kırbayır, oğlunun akıbetini öğrenmek için yıllarca mücadele etti. 5 Şubat 2011’de dönemin Başbakanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’la Dolmabahçe Sarayı’nda görüşen Kırbayır, “Ben ölmeden oğlumu bul” talebini iletti.


Görüşmenin ardından TBMM İnsan Haklarını İnceleme Komisyonu bünyesinde Kırbayır’ın akıbetini araştıran bir alt komisyon çalışma yürüttü. Komisyon, döneme ait belgeleri inceledi; Kırbayır’ı sorgu sırasında gören tanıkların yanı sıra emniyet ve MİT mensuplarını dinledi.


Komisyon, Kırbayır’ın gözaltında işkence gördüğü, işkence sonucu hayatını kaybettiği ve bedeninin ölümüne neden olan sorgulamaları yapan kamu görevlilerince ortadan kaldırıldığı kanaatine vardı.


Soruşturma zamanaşımından kapatıldı


Meclis komisyonu Kars Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı’na suç duyurusunda bulunurken, Kırbayır’ın kaybedilmesine ilişkin soruşturma yeniden açıldı.


Adalet Bakanlığı, 25 Şubat 2020’de Yargıtay’a başvurarak dosyada zamanaşımı yönünden “kanun yararına bozma” kararı verilmesini istedi. Yargıtay 8. Ceza Dairesi talebi kabul etti. Kars Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı da 28 Aralık 2021’de kovuşturmaya yer olmadığına karar vererek soruşturmayı zamanaşımı gerekçesiyle kapattı.


İkbal Eren, “Gözaltında kaybetme suçunda zamanaşımı işletilemez” dedi.


Devletin etkin soruşturma yapma yükümlülüğünü yerine getirmeyip yıllarca dosyaları sürüncemede bırakması, ardından “zamanaşımı doldu” diyerek soruşturma ve kovuşturmaları kapatması yalnızca bir usul sorunu değildir. Bu, hukukun inkârıdır. Cezasızlığın kurumsallaştırılmasıdır.

Cumartesi Anneleri/İnsanları 1121. hafta açıklamasından


Eren, Cemil Kırbayır’ın akıbeti açıklanana ve onu gözaltında kaybedenler yargılanana kadar Berfo Kırbayır’ın bıraktığı yerden sormayı sürdüreceklerini söyledi.


Keskin: “Zamanaşımı örtbas aracı olarak kullanılıyor”


Kırbayır ailesinin avukatlarından Eren Keskin de Türkiye’nin Birleşmiş Milletler’in zorla kaybetmelere karşı sözleşmesini imzalamamasına dikkat çekti.


Türkiye Cumhuriyeti Devleti, Birleşmiş Milletler Gözaltında Kayıplara Karşı Sözleşme’yi imzalamıyor. Çünkü imzalarsa zamanaşımı durumu ortadan kalkacak. Devletin zamanaşımını bir örtbas aracı olarak kullandığını düşünüyorum. Zamanaşımını kullanarak bu tür faili meçhul cinayetlerin, faili bulunabilecek cinayetlerin üstünü örtüyor.

–Avukat Eren Keskin


Cemil Kırbayır’ın kardeşi Mikail Kırbayır ise “Devletin gözaltında kaybettiği insanların aileleri, ne çekti, hangi travmaları yaşadı? Her canlı dünya gelir ölümle yüzleşir ama bizim ki farklı bir durum. Benim kardeşim katledildi” dedi.

title: Catamarca: Entrevista a vocero de Comunidad Indígena Peñas Negras
content:
Entrevista a vocero de Comunidad I

ndígena Peñas Negras


En relación al hostigamiento que reciben de la empresa minera amparada por el gobierno provincial y nacional.


Entrevista a Martín Pachado, de la comunidad indígena Peñas Negras.

Realizada

por Andrés López Raml 

el 13 de Septiembre.


Video 1 

https://youtube.com/shorts/5aEMBxWizIU?feature=share


Video 2


https://youtu.be/9smmERqLxU0


.


Una de las primeras cosas que le plantié, es esta situación de «denuncia» que algunas personas hicieron sobre su persona, calificándolo de «mentiroso», o «estafador».


Es el contacto que todos mis contactos en Catamarca me ofrecieron como integrante de la Comunidad Indígena de Peñas Negras. Es vocero, secretario, prensa de la comunidad.


A lo que me responde:


«Para desvincular, digamos.


Estos son gente que realmente están pagadas por la empresa para hacer todas estas cosas, ¿no?


Son cinco comunidades que están en contra, digamos, de nuestra comunidad de Peñas Negras. Y son quienes se patotan, digamos, para violentarnos.


Incluye la justicia, incluye todo Catamarca, todo lo que es realmente a nivel de la minería.


Así que no.


Nosotros vivimos del ganado, vivimos de la llama, de la oveja, que son lugares de crianza.


La gente, a través de eso, por eso defiende el agua y lo que es mantener la naturaleza viva.


Sabemos que mucha gente está totalmente en contra, nos quieren ver solos, nos quieren hostigar, porque somos la única comunidad que resistimos.


No vamos a bajar los brazo, sinceramente.


Hice ese flayer para que sinceramente no había uno que tengamos la cuenta disponible.


Bueno, yo presté mi ayuda para poder ver que nos puedan acompañar.


Que es complicado poder atravesar esta situación por el frío, el viento.


Y también no nos estaban dejar pasar lo que es los alimentos. Tenían bloqueados los caminos.


Y bueno, buscamos la forma de poder hacer llegar, así que, ahora un poquito mejor en el sentido de los alimentos, que nos trababa todo, digamos. Teníamos que traspasar de a moto para poder buscar las cosas, el combustible, y eso.»


Así, que bueno, queda en vuestra consideración, queride lectore, querida lectora, querido lector, de si confían o no, pero si les quedaba alguna duda, pues vean el primer video, ya que le pedí un video con el cacique o algo similar, y dijo que ya tenía ese video recientemente hecho y que me lo pasaba. Y ahí está, el primer video que acompaña este texto.


Desde mi entender, esta acción de ensuciar, o enbarrar la cancha, o salpicar dudas sobre personas que luchan y resisten el avasallamiento del capitalismo superturboacelerado, si bien no es novedad, es a tener en cuenta en todos los territorios cuyas multitudes o comunidades o colectivos o frentes resisten tanto atropello.


Se complican las distancias y las regiones difíciles de acceder y de comunicarse.


Lo central en todo caso es no aflojar con la solidaridad en sí, sea cual fuera que puedas dar, porque el hecho concreto es que una comunidad indígena está siendo hostigada desde hace años, y muy recientemente con renovada insistencia y violencia.


Entonces la entrevista sigue así:


Le digo a Martín Pachado que es mucho hostigamiento y que se ha incrementado en los recientes ocho días, ¿Es así?


«Exactamente. Tal Cual.


Han bajado a hacer denuncia contra la Comunidad de Peñas Negras.


Hasta el momentos, ayer y hoy no subieron, pero bueno, nosotros seguimos en alerta en el cerro.


Y bueno, y lo importante es que nosotros, mantener esta postura y seguramente … mantenernos en espera porque mañana dicen que se va a convocar una reunión con el gobierno.


Pero bueno, el gobierno ya viene de tiempo manteniendo reuniones con los caciques, con los que apoyan a la minera.


De parte nuestra, de nuestra comunidad, tuvimos dos reuniones con el señor gobernador, donde se le dijo que no queremos la minería y fue clara. Y él nunca respetó y nunca hizo la consulta libre, previo e informado, así que él siguió creando el conflicto.»


Otro antecedente es el del 2024, le digo que me acuerdo, cuando la policía golpeó a un anciano indígena.


«Sí, eso ha sido el 11 de Abril del 2024.


A la hora cuatro y algo eran. Ese día justo estabamos yo y el abuelito, estaba una hija de él y estaban otros niños más.


Justo ellos estaban pastoreando las ovejas.


Más o menos ya teníamos conocido que estos iban a salir y bueno, nos agarraron. Eramos cinco. Y empezaron a golpizar. Y bueno a mí me metieron balas de goma.

title: Ernten von Wassermelonen in den USA: Erntemaschinen und H-2A-Visa konzentrieren die Macht bei den Landwirten und entziehen sie den selbstorganisierten Arbeitsteams
content:
„…

Das Ernten von Wassermelonen ist brutale Schwerstarbeit, die bei extremer Hitze verrichtet wird, aber so gut koordiniert ist, dass es fast wie ein Tanz wirkt. (…) Sie laufen fast, während sie die Reihen entlanggehen. Im Laufe eines Tages wechseln sie die Positionen, sodass jeder Arbeiter schließlich abwechselnd die schwereren und die leichteren Aufgaben übernimmt. Sie arbeiten so schnell, dass sie nie länger als einen Tag, höchstens zwei, an einem Ort bleiben. Bis vor kurzem verschaffte diese Art von körperlicher Arbeit den Arbeitern die Möglichkeit, bessere Schutzmaßnahmen auszuhandeln und durchzusetzen. Doch die zunehmende Vergabe von Visa für befristete Landarbeiter in Verbindung mit einem zunehmend mechanisierten Ernteprozess hat für diese Arbeiter große Veränderungen mit sich gebracht

…“ engl.

Fotoreportage von David Bacon am 17. September 2026 in Barn Raiser


 und mehr daraus:


Weiter aus der (sehr sehenswerten und zugleich informativen!) engl.

Fotoreportage von David Bacon am 17. September 2026 in Barn Raiser


 („A New System of Labor Threatens Farmworker Power“, maschinenübersetzt): „…

Die Arbeitsgruppe, die ich auf dem Höhepunkt der Sommerhitze traf, arbeitete am südlichen Ende des San-Joaquin-Tals, unweit von Arvin. Um 5:30 Uhr an jenem Morgen, als die Sonne aufging, säumten die Autos der Arbeiter bereits die Landstraßen und Autobahnen des Tals, direkt neben einem Feld nach dem anderen. Noch vor Tagesanbruch strömten die Menschen aus ihren Fahrzeugen in die Reihen und Rebstöcke. Durch den frühen Arbeitsbeginn konnten sie sieben oder acht Stunden Arbeit erledigen, bevor die Hitze ihren Höhepunkt erreichte. (…)


Als ich mich auf den Weg ins Feld machte, um die Fotos zu schießen, wusste ich, dass ich keinen Vorgesetzten um Erlaubnis bitten musste. Die Wassermelonen-Teams arbeiten ohne Vorarbeiter, daher brauchte ich lediglich ihre Zustimmung, um sie zu fotografieren. Diese Arbeiter sind stolz auf ihre Fähigkeit und ihre Bereitschaft, diese schwere Arbeit Tag für Tag in glühender Hitze zu verrichten. Sie freuten sich, einem Weißen mit einer Kamera zu zeigen, was sie leisten können.


Ich fotografiere solche Teams schon seit Jahrzehnten. Mitten auf einem Feld hat man nicht viel Zeit zum Fotografieren. Die Leute arbeiten und wollen nicht aufhören, vor allem wenn sie, wie die Melonenwerfer, im Akkord arbeiten. Wenn man Bilder von Menschen bei der Arbeit machen will, muss man das im Vorbeigehen tun. Man lernt, rückwärts zu gehen, gleichzeitig zu schauen, zu reden und zu fotografieren – alles auf einmal. Das allein verschafft einem schon Respekt. (…)


Eine bestimmte Arbeitsgruppe reist monatelang gemeinsam und zieht von Feldern nahe der mexikanischen Grenze nach Norden durch Kalifornien, Oregon und Washington, während die zunehmende Hitze die Früchte reifen lässt. Im Winter leben die meisten Wassermelonenarbeiter in den Grenzstädten Mexicali und Calexico im Imperial Valley sowie in den Partnerstädten San Luis in Arizona und San Luis Río Colorado in Sonora. Einige wenige leben im Coachella Valley, eine Stunde nördlich der Grenze. Während der Erntezeit sind sie unterwegs und sehen ihre Familien erst wieder, wenn die Ernte vorbei ist und sie nach Hause zurückkehren.


Manche Teams arbeiten als Kollektiv und kehren Jahr für Jahr zu denselben Feldern und Erzeugern zurück, wobei sie direkt mit dem Erzeuger verhandeln. In früheren Jahren verschafften die Verhandlungsmethode der Teams und ihre Kontrolle über das Arbeitstempo ihnen viel Verhandlungsmacht und führten zu einer besseren Bezahlung. Wassermelonen-Arbeitsgruppen werden als Gruppe bezahlt, 150 Dollar pro Anhänger. Der Anhänger auf diesem Feld fasste 16 volle Behälter, was insgesamt etwa 500 Wassermelonen entspricht. Sie teilen das Geld gleichmäßig auf, was pro Person und Anhänger etwa 20 Dollar ergab. Sie können 7–8 Anhänger beladen, bevor es für diese schwere körperliche Arbeit zu heiß wird.


Auch andere Landarbeiter haben ihre Arbeitsgruppen genutzt, um durch die Kontrolle über die Arbeit bessere Löhne zu erzielen. Salatschnitzer verfügten über eine ähnliche Macht und waren in sogenannten „Ground Crews“ von 30 bis 40 Arbeitern organisiert, die in Dreiergruppen aufgeteilt waren: zwei schnitten, einer packte die Kisten. Sie konnten die Menge an Salat, die sie pro Tag schnitten, selbst bestimmen und verlangsamten das Tempo oder legten sogar eine Pause ein, um eine Erhöhung des Stücklohns zu erzwingen. author: Ali Harb
title: Arab Americans Feel Betrayed After Michigan Grants $1M to Israeli Contractor
content:
Rep. Rashida Tlaib says Capture Systems has “no place in our state and should not be receiving a dime of public funds.”

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Amid Israel’s offensive in south Lebanon, Nasser Beydoun — like many Arab Americans who hail from the area — would look at satellite images of his hometown of Bint Jbeil to see if his family house is still standing.

Israel has been wiping out entire towns on the Lebanese side of the border as part of a deliberate policy that human rights advocates say aims to make the region uninhabitable.

After a ceasefire between Israeli forces and Hezbollah was announced in April, an image came through showing the house was gone.

For Beydoun, a civil rights advocate in the Detroit area’s large Arab community, the loss was immense, but hope persists.

“It makes you very angry, but it also makes you very determined,” he said. “They can destroy a house. They can’t destroy the memories in the house. They can destroy a village, but we’re going to rebuild all that.”

Now, an Israeli military contractor will open a hub to produce military technology in the Detroit suburb of Sterling Heights, less than 30 miles away from where Beydoun lives. The firm, Capture Systems Ltd., is set to receive $1 million in backing from the state’s investment arm, the Michigan Economic Development Corporation (MEDC). The company, which will operate under a U.S.-based entity called Capture Group Inc., specializes in military surveillance and anti-drone technology.

“It just shows you that the state is out of touch with reality. The MEDC is out of touch with reality, and we need to hold them accountable,” Beydoun told Truthout.

Thousands of Michiganders, who have lost their homes or had their loved ones killed in south Lebanon, are contending with what they describe as a sense of betrayal by their own state officials. Members of the Arab community are expressing outrage at the policy.

Amer Zahr, a school board trustee in the Detroit suburb of Dearborn, a city known as the “Capital of Arab America,” called the state’s decision a “slap in the face to the hundreds of thousands of Arab Americans in Michigan.”

“This Israeli company produces the exact kind of military … technology used to ethnically cleanse Palestinians in the West Bank and to undertake a genocide in Gaza,” Zahr told Truthout.

Gov. Gretchen Whitmer hailed the move in the Michigan Economic Development Corporation announcement, touting it as an achievement that shows that Michigan is “on the move and open for business.”

While Whitmer has promised that the project would create 125 “new good-paying jobs,” critics say the investment adds insult to the suffering of the governor’s constituents of Palestinian and Lebanese descent. “I’m sure most Michiganders would agree that legitimizing war crimes for potentially creating 125 jobs is a moral catastrophe,” Zahr told Truthout.

Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib said Capture Group Inc. is “not welcome” in Michigan.

“Governor Whitmer’s administration is now in the weapons business.”

“Governor Whitmer’s administration is now in the weapons business. Michigan is awarding nearly $1 million to an Israeli weapons and drones company to start production in our state. This is an anti-war and anti-genocide state,” Tlaib told Truthout in an email.

Tlaib and Whitmer are both Democrats, but the congresswoman has not shied away from criticizing the governor, including over environmental policies and her pro-Israel positions.

“When small businesses, many of them Black- and women-owned, are struggling in our state, there never seems to be money for them, but Governor Whitmer has funding for bombs that kill children,” Tlaib added. “These weapons have been used to commit genocide and murder the family members and loved ones of so many of our neighbors. They have no place in our state and should not be receiving a dime of public funds.”

Leading rights groups and United Nations experts and investigators have accused Israel of carrying out a genocide in Gaza — a push to destroy the Palestinian people in whole or in part.

Beydoun also slammed Whitmer for celebrating the creation of 125 jobs to justify working with Israel’s military-industrial sector. “Really? 125 jobs to back a company that backs genocide and backs the Israeli military in a state where a lot of your constituents have suffered under Israel’s war,” Beydoun said.

author: Adam Mahoney
title: Some Black Los Angelenos May Soon Receive Environmental Reparations
content:
New legislation would steer $5 million collected from penalized oil wells into cash aid for 1,000 nearby households.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

As a child in the 1950s and ’60s, Regina Martin became so used to the oil pumpjacks near her home that she assumed every child lived beside them. Everyone was made “sick to [their] tummy” by the sulfurous, rotten-egg smell that never seemed to leave, she thought.

Only until she was grown did she begin to see a possible connection between growing up on top of the nation’s largest urban oil drilling field and her own sickness and the asthma that affected her sister.

For over a century in Los Angeles and across the nation, Black people have been disproportionately likely to live near oil wells, the machinery that draws oil from deep underground. The pollution from these drilling sites are connected to birth complications, child development issues, respiratory illnesses, and cancer.

Now, a new California state law moves to turn that lived experience into a broader public-policy question: What does a state owe communities exposed to pollution for generations? And what happens when you can’t offer support to every family that has struggled through the harm?

California lawmakers have passed AB 1661, which would steer $5 million collected from penalized oil wells in Inglewood into direct cash aid for 1,000 nearby households with qualifying respiratory or reproductive health impacts. Some of LA’s Blackest suburbs and city neighborhoods, including Inglewood, Ladera Heights, and Baldwin Hills, surround the oil field.

The legislation, introduced by Assemblymember Isaac G. Bryan, is expected to be signed into law by Gov. Gavin Newsom by October. It sets aside enough money for payments of up to $5,000 for 1,000 impacted households under its initial structure. The money would come from the state’s community repair and reinvestment fund for people living nearest the oil field.

For Black communities living nearest to refineries, highways, landfills, and oil wells, this fund may signal something larger than one oil field or payment. It asks whether money can begin to repair harms accumulated across generations: lives cut short by illness, household wealth drained by medical bills and depressed property values, and the anxiety of raising children amid pollution.

Bryan and other supporters are calling it environmental reparations and say it is a model that could be replicated to make industrial companies help repair the damage borne by people living closest to polluting sites.

To Tianna Shaw-Wakeman, the environmental justice program director with Black Women for Wellness in LA, the law could provide a national organizing model. “My hope has always come at the community level, at the grassroots level,” she said. “I see how grassroots organizing has created long-term change in our local communities, and I see that that can be and is being replicated all over the country.”

For Bryan, who represents the communities surrounding the Inglewood Oil Field, the cash-assistance program is part of a longer fight over the field’s legacy. Bryan, the first Black legislator to chair the California Assembly’s Natural Resources Committee, said his constituents have faced lower life expectancies and higher rates of asthma and heart conditions for decades.

“The company has essentially just been extracting from the community with no investments in the community, no care in the community and what feels like no regard at times for the broader community,” Bryan told Capital B. “The community … [is] due this repair, and it’s been long overdue.”

The measure builds on Bryan’s earlier legislation, AB 2716, which Newsom signed in 2024. That law requires the Inglewood Oil Field to close by 2030 and establish a penalty structure for low-producing wells. Low-producing wells can leak methane and other harmful gases into the air and water. To push operators to curb that pollution and clean up their sites, regulators imposed a penalty on companies that keep such wells operating. Bryan said operators are charged $10,000 per well each month, with the revenue directed into a community repair fund restricted to investments within 2.5 miles of the field.

The fund could eventually support affordable housing, urban greening, park infrastructure, and other community priorities, Bryan said. Bryan …

author: Frances Madeson
title: Indigenous Tribes Form Resistance Camp Against Proposed Copper Mine in Michigan
content:
The proposed copper sulfide mine threatens to unleash 40 million tons of toxic waste in Michigan’s wetlands.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

Anahkwet (Guy Reiter), a member of the Menominee nation and a longtime community organizer, remembers the counsel of his elders about what to do when times get thorny, tangled, and twisted. “If I’m struggling with something in my life, if I’m having a hard time, I was taught to go outside and walk,” Anahkwet told Truthout. “The earth will show me something that I haven’t seen before, or a way of reframing the way I’m looking at something, and I trust it. I trust that that’s the connection I have to our beautiful Mother and her reaching out to me, saying, ‘There now, it doesn’t have to be so hard.’”

The difficulties northern tribes are facing on their shared ancestral lands in the Porcupine Mountains of Michigan’s Western Upper Peninsula have recently become acutely thorny, as they stare down an industrial buildout in the last uncut old-growth forest in the region. Charlotte Loonsfoot, a tribal member of the Keweenaw Bay Indian Community (KBIC), told Truthout she had the same impulse: to go into the wilderness, build a sacred fire in community, and make offerings to the spirits.

Camp Animikiiwadiswan, or Thunderbird Nest resistance camp, co-led by Loonsfoot and Anahkwet, is their inter-tribal, three-dimensional answer to a proposed copper sulfide mine that would generate copious amounts of toxic waste — an estimated 40 millions tons of mining tailings — in a high-risk location. The project, which Loonsfoot’s tribe has vehemently opposed, is set to be financed by a contentious $50 million taxpayer subsidy in the form of “site readiness” grants to Copperwood Resources Inc., a U.S. subsidiary of Highland Copper, a Canadian company. KBIC’s letter of opposition to the Michigan legislature detailed multiple harms Highland Copper had already caused to the area’s wetlands, calling its mining operations “irresponsible.”

The camp’s name, Loonsfoot said, was inspired by a petroglyph carved into the rock just below where the mine is planned — the rock carving depicts a diamond emerging from a lightning bolt. At its opening from August 14-16, Thunderbird Nest camp was attended by 20 people, and by the second weekend it had doubled in size. “We go out there and honor the life spirits with food, small gifts, and tobacco,” Loonsfoot said, “and we hope they’ll wake up and see that our people are coming in a good way.”

Loonsfoot is hoping for guidance to a better resolution than the current, distorted three-year political process, which devolved into a serious conflict that finds the Michigan Economic Development Corporation (MEDC) and Michigan Strategic Fund (MSF) coming under fire. On August 25, MSF’s board approved the grants for the mine despite the company’s failure to meet financing conditions it had imposed in 2024. Nor have the expenditures been approved by the state legislature: The Senate Appropriations Committee declined to vote on it in 2024 and twice more when it was proposed in 2025. MSF’s stark divergence from past practice prompted Michigan State Senator Jeff Irwin to call MSF’s action “wrong and possibly illegal.” Former MSF board member Cindy Warner also spoke out against the project, promising she “will follow as far as the trail can lead,” and explaining to the Michigan Advance that Copperwood Resources, Inc. didn’t have the requisite proof of financial viability in 2024, and it still doesn’t. In a recent PBS segment, Tom Grotewohl, founder of Protect the Porkies, a grassroots group mobilizing the opposition to the mine, described MSF’s action as “a coup d’etat.” Protect the Porkies is now seeking an official investigation by the state’s attorney general and appropriations committees.

When Truthout asked about the authority the MSF board was relying upon and whether the previous conditions it had set for Copperwood in 2024 had been resolved, MEDC spokesperson Danielle Emerson offered the same accounting justification reported by multiple other outlets. “While the MEDC accounted for it internally, with the expectation of using it for projects in our pipeline, those projects did not ultimately move forward,” Emerson wrote.

Perhaps the most damning critique of the deal was leveled on August 28 by economist Scott Beaulier. Born and raised in Michigan’s Upper …

title: Filo Jet soruşturmasında gözaltı süreleri uzatıldı, can kaybı 15’e yükseldi
content:
Kuzey Kıbrıs Türk Cumhuriyeti (KKTC) Başbakanlığı’nın bugün yaptığı açıklamaya göre, Girne açıklarında 30 Ağustos’ta batan Filo Jet’te kayıp olarak aranan bir kişinin daha bedenine ulaşıldı.


Başbakan Ünal Üstel, hayatını kaybedenlerin sayısının 15’e yükseldiğini, 13 kişinin ise halen kayıp olduğunu açıkladı. Kayıpları arama çalışmaları sürüyor.


Türkiye’den gelen özel donanımlı “Optimus Prime” gemisi arama çalışmalarını sürdürüyor. TCG Işın ve TCG Alemdar ise bölgeden ayrıldı.


Geminin batmasına ilişkin soruşturma da devam ediyor. Gözaltındaki dokuz şüphelinin gözaltı süresi dün (18 Eylül) yedi gün daha uzatılırken, polis soruşturmada geminin daha önce gördüğü hasar ve onarımlara ilişkin yeni bulgulara ulaştı.


Girne’deki feribot kazasında kaybolan kişiler hakkında neler biliyoruz?


31 Ağustos 2026


Kırığın onarımına ilişkin fotoğraflar bulundu


Türk Ajansı Kıbrıs’ın (TAK)

haberine göre, Girne açıklarında batan yolcu gemisiyle ilgili soruşturmada zanlılar dördüncü kez Girne Kaza Mahkemesi’ne çıkarıldı.


Polis Müfettiş Muavini Mehmet Mannaş, duruşmada soruşturma kapsamında bugüne kadar 300’ün üzerinde ifade aldıklarını, Türkiye ve Kuzey Kıbrıs’taki birçok kuruma yazı gönderdiklerini söyledi. Hakkında yakalama emri bulunan beş kişinin ise arandığını belirtti.


Mannaş ayrıca, soruşturma kapsamında yardımcı kaptanın gönüllü olarak ifade verdiğini, bu ifadenin ardından zanlılardan alınan WhatsApp yazışmalarında geminin sol ön kızağının uç kısmında bulunan bir kırığın üstünkörü tamir edildiğine dair fotoğraflar tespit edildiğini söyledi.


Fotoğrafların 17 Haziran tarihli olduğunu belirten Mannaş, söz konusu tamiratın, kaptanın emriyle gemide çalışan bir mürettebat tarafından yapıldığının tespit edildiğini ve tamiratı gösteren fotoğrafların kaptana ve hakkında yakalama emri bulunan bir şirket yetkilisine gönderildiğini ifade etti.


Geminin sol ön kızağı kırıldığı için alabora olup battığını aktaran Mannaş, kaza sırasındaki hava durumu hakkında Meteoroloji Dairesinden anlık hava durumu bilgisi alındığını kaydetti.


FİLO JET GEMİ KAZASI


Bir yolcu gemisi hangi koşullarda sefere çıkabilir?


31 Ağustos 2026


Haziranda geminin su aldığına dair bir videonun basına yansıdığını hatırlatan Mannaş, bu videonun emare olarak alındığını, videoyu kaydeden şahsın da ifadesinin alındığını bildirdi.


Mannaş, geminin tüm evraklarının da Gazimağusa Limanı’ndan orijinalleri temin edilerek kontrol edildiğini belirtti.


Geminin evraklarının “Tamam” olduğunu ifade eden Mannaş, gemi jurnaline, sistemde oluşan bir arıza sebebiyle ulaşılamadığını söyledi.


Mannaş, gemi jurnalinde acil durum eğitimi kayıtları ve gemi çalışanlarının görev bilgilerinin de kayıtlı olması gerektiğini aktardı.


Geminin 30 Nisan 2024’te Akdeniz Tersanesi’nde tamir gördüğü bilgisini paylaşan Mannaş, tespit edilen fotoğrafla birlikte Akdeniz Tersanesi’ne gidilerek söz konusu kırık hakkında soruşturma yapılacağını vurguladı.


CTP’li Akansoy: Filo Jet gemi kazası münferit bir olay değil


1 Eylül 2026


2003 kazasına ilişkin raporların tercümesi sürüyor


Mannaş, geminin daha önce geçirdiği kazaya ilişkin 2003 tarihli farklı dillerde hazırlanan raporların tercüman aracılığıyla Türkçeye çevrilmesi işlemlerinin devam ettiğini söyledi.


Gemiye ilişkin Türk Loydu’ndan yazı beklendiğini, geminin bakım ve denetim geçmişine ilişkin soruşturmanın devam ettiğini, geçmiş hasar kayıtlarının araştırıldığını aktaran Mannaş, Limanlar Dairesi’nin yükümlülüğü ile gemiye izin verilmeden önce hangi kriterlerin değerlendirildiği konularındaki araştırmaların da sürdüğünü dile getirdi.


Kazanın teknik açıdan değerlendirilmesi amacıyla Türkiye’den bilirkişi heyetinin gelmesi için de yazı yazıldığını bildiren Mannaş, geminin kara kutusuna henüz ulaşılamadığını da ifade etti.


Mahkeme önünde bekleyen bazı kayıp yakınları da şüphelilerin getirilişi ve götürülüşü sırasında tepki gösterdi. Kayıpların fotoğraflarını taşıyan yakınları adalet çağrısı yaptı.


Filo Jet gemi kazası raporu ne söylüyor?

Ne olmuştu?


Kuzey Kıbrıs’taki Girne Limanı ile Mersin’deki Taşucu Limanı arasında sefer yapan Filo Jet adlı yüksek hızlı yolcu gemisi, 30 Ağustos Pazar günü Girne’den hareket ettikten kısa süre sonra ön bölümünden su almaya başladı.

title: Dicle'de 1996'da öldürülen Hatice Atalay için adalet çağrısı
content:
İnsan Hakları Derneği (İHD) Batman Şubesi ve kayıp yakınları, her hafta düzenledikleri “Kayıplar Bulunsun, Failler Yargılansın” eylemi kapsamında bu hafta 10 Eylül 1996’da Diyarbakır’ın Dicle ilçesinde öldürülen Hatice Atalay için bir araya geldi.

Şube Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Hüseyin Elçi tarafından okunan basın metninde, kayıpların akıbetlerinin ortaya çıkarılması ve faillerin yargılanması talep edildi. Açıklamada, aradan geçen yıllara rağmen kayıplara ilişkin hakikatlerin ortaya çıkarılmadığı ve adaletin sağlanmadığı belirtildi.

Hatice Atalay’ın oğlu Hacı Atalay’ın anlatımına göre olay, 10 Eylül 1996 gecesi Dicle’de meydana geldi. Atalay, annesi Hatice Atalay, babası ve komşuları Hatice Akkoç’un, Dicle Emniyet Müdürlüğü'nün karşısında bulunan sebze bahçelerini sulamak için evden yaklaşık 1 kilometre uzaklıktaki bölgeye gittiklerini söyledi.

Sulama sırasının kendilerinde olduğunun daha önce emniyete bildirildiğini belirten Hacı Atalay, bahçenin sulanmaya başlanmasından bir süre sonra Emniyet Müdürlüğü'nün arka tarafındaki Ziyaret Tepesi’nden uzun namlulu silahlarla ateş açıldığını ifade etti.

Atalay, ilk ateşin ardından yeniden seri şekilde ateş edildiğini, babasının Emniyet Müdürlüğü'ne doğru koşarak ateş edilmemesini istediğini belirtti. Hacı Atalay’ın anlatımına göre babasına bir polis tarafından “Seni de öldüreceğiz” denildi ve annesinin yaralandığını, hastaneye götürmek istediğini söylemesine rağmen sabaha kadar bekletildi.

Hacı Atalay, olay yerine sabah saat 06.00’a kadar savcı ve doktor getirilmediğini, geldiklerinde ise annesinin hayatını kaybettiğinin belirlendiğini aktardı.

Atalay, emniyet yetkililerinin olay yerinde mermi bulunmadığını ve olayla ilgilerinin olmadığını söylediklerini belirterek, olay sırasında bölgede sokağa çıkma yasağı bulunduğunu ve babasına “Siz de dışarı çıkmasaydınız” denildiğini ifade etti.

İHD Batman Şubesi açıklamasında, insanlığa karşı işlendiği belirtilen suçlar karşısında sessiz kalınamayacağı ifade edildi. Yargıya görevini yerine getirme çağrısı yapılan açıklamada, kayıplara ilişkin hakikatin ortaya çıkarılması ve sorumluların yargılanması için yasal düzenlemeler yapılması talep edildi.

Açıklamada, “Kayıplarımızın akıbetini sorgularken, onlara dair bir izi bulmadan, hakikatler ortaya çıkarılmadan ve adalet sağlanmadan bu mücadeleden asla geri adım atmayacağız” denildi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Narin Güran'ın babası 'Adalet Yürüyüşü' başlattı
content:
Diyarbakır’ın Bağlar ilçesine bağlı Tavşantepe Mahallesi’nde 2024 yılında kaybolduktan 19 gün sonra cenazesi bulunan Narin Güran'ın babası Arif Güran olayın aydınlatılması için Ankara'ya doğru “Adalet Yürüyüşü” başlattı.

Yürüyüşten önce Narin Güran'ın mezarının bulunduğu Tavşantepe Mahallesi’nde konuşan Güran ailesinin avukatı Onur Akdağ, şunları söyledi: “2 yıldır ailenin verdiği hukuk mücadelesine hep birlikte şahit olduk. Dosyanın başında soruşturmanın eksik olmasıyla birlikte soruşturma başında DARA-2 askeri üs kamera görüntüleri silindi. Salim Güran’ın telefonundaki ses kayıtları silindi. Nevzat Bahtiyar’ın telefonu kollukta sıfırlanmaya çalışıldı. Ailenin ağır işkence taleplerini mahkemeye ilettik. Kovuşturma aşamasında Whatshapp raporunun sahte olduğu tespit edildi. Daraltılmış baz raporunun ses ve kamera kayıtlarıyla birlikte dijital verilerle çeliştiği yüzde 100 tespit edildi. 2 Metre 1 dakika sapma sayı olduğu denilen daraltılmış baz raporunun safsatadan ibaret olduğu açıkça ıspat edilmiş oldu bu davada.

Ulusal Kriminal Büro’nun bir karartıyı göstererek ‘Narin patikayı çıkmıştır’ diyen mahkemeyi yanıltan tespitinin aksine ABD’de iyileştirdiğimiz görüntüde Narin’in eve varmadığı, patikanın başında Nevzat olarak tahmin ettiğimiz şahıs tarafından çocuğun alınarak Nevzat Bahtiyar’ın ahırı tarafına getirdiğini net bir şekilde tespit edip, raporlayıp mahkemeye sunduk. Kovuşturma aşamasında telefon imaj kayıtlarında aldırdığımız rapora göre Salim Güran’ın daraltılmış baz raporunda ki Arif’in ahırı, evi ve müştemilatı yönüne gittiği tespitinin aksine Salim Güran’ın evinde çocuklarıyla oturduğu ve yemek yediğini tespit ettik. Salim Güran cinayetin ilk 30 dakikasında sıfır. İkinci 30 dakikasında 45 adım atmış ve tamda cinayet saatinde internet veri hareketliliği söz konusu.

Nevzat Bahtiyar’ın telefonunun ölü gibi olduğunun internet hareketliliğinin olmadığını tespit ettik. Salim Güran’ın evinde fatura ödediği, şarj verisine göre telefonun şarjda olduğunu tespit ettik. Bunca veriler dikkate alınmadığı gibi Narin’in üzerindeki en büyük gerçeklik olan PSA’da dikkate alınmamış Normal bir cinayette 8 yaşındaki çocuğun en mahrem yerinde bulunan PSA başlı başına ‘Cinsel İstismar’ emaresi görülürken Narin’in hakkı yerde kalmıştır. Neticede Yerel Mahkeme, İstinaf Mahkemesi ve Yargıtay’ın toplum baskısıyla verdiği karar toplumu tatmin etmemiş, acele karar vermiştir.”

Arif Güran’ın buna karşı “Adalet Yürüyüşü”ne karar verdiğini söylediğini Akdağ, Arif Güran’ın Adalet Yürüyüşü’nün temel amacının Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’a sesini duyurmak olduğunu söyledi. Akdağ, “Bu yüzden Adalet mücadelemizi yeniden başlatıyoruz” dedi.

Ardından konuşan Narin Güran’ın babası Arif Güran ise “2 yıldır hukuk mücadelesi veriyoruz. Burada kimseye dosya hakkında bir şeyden bahsetmeyeceğiz. Vicdanlı insanlara sesleniyoruz. Bu yola çıkmamın tek sebebi kızımın hakkıdır, hakikatidir. Ben Narin için değil yollara Narin için ölemeye hazırım. Narin’in hakikatini savunan binlerce insan var onlara sesleniyorum. Ben onun hakkını savunuyorsam, sizlerin de savunacağına inanıyorum. Bu yola gitmemin tek sebebi kızımın hakikatidir. Bin kilometre gideceğim yolda; Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’a sesleniyorum; Benim kızımın hakkını yerde bırakmayan bu ülkede tek bir kişi var o da Sayın Cumhurbaşkanı’dır. Bu yol sadece ona gitmek içindir. Buradan çıkışın Ankara’da varışım külliyenin önü olacaktır. Narin için hakikat, Narin için Adalet sloganımdır” diye konuştu.

Arif Güran devamla şunları söyledi: “Bir ayda sürse iki ayda sürse ne olursa olsun bu yolda devam edeceğim. Yarı yolda bana deseler ailenden ölenler var, ailen gözaltına alındı ne olursa olsun bu yolu bırakmayacağım. Ben Narin’in hakkını, hakikatini bırakmayacağım. Ölsem de tutuklansam da onun hakikatini bırakmayacağız. Bir yılda olsa 1 ayda olsa ben bu yoldan vazgeçmeyeceğim. Ben her gün öleceğime bir gün ölürüm. Bu yolda ölümümde olursa ölümün kızımın hakkının yolunda olacaktır. Ne yaparlarsa yapsınlar bu yoldan bu davadan vazgeçmeyeceğim. Yeniden yargılanma istiyorum."

Açıklamanın ardından Arif Güran kent çıkışına giderek yola koyuldu.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Alerta
title: Αλληλεγγύη στο Autistici/Inventati
content:
Αλληλεγγύη στο Autistici/Inventati.


Aναδημοσίευση από το

gizmo_lab

.


Στις 6 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026, η ιστορική κολεκτίβα Autistici/Inventati (A/I) αναγκάστηκε να

ανακοινώσει το οριστικό της κλείσιμο

. Πρόκειται για την επίσημη, κρατικά οργανωμένη εξόντωση ενός από τα πιο μακρόβια και πιο έμπιστα εργαλεία ψηφιακής αυτοάμυνας που έχει γνωρίσει το ευρωπαϊκό ελευθεριακό κίνημα.


Το A/I λειτουργούσε επί 25 χρόνια ως μη κερδοσκοπική, αυτοδιαχειριζόμενη υποδομή προσφέροντας υπηρεσίες email, hosting, blogs, mailing lists, κλπ. Η αρχή τους ήταν το  “socializzare saperi senza fondare poteri” (να μοιράζεσαι γνώση χωρίς να θεμελιώνεις εξουσία). Στήριξε αντιφασιστικά, αντικαπιταλιστικά, φεμινιστικά και queer εγχειρήματα, ανεξάρτητα ΜΜΕ και χιλιάδες ακτιβίστριες και ακτιβιστές που δεν είχαν πού αλλού να εμπιστευτούν την επικοινωνία τους. Δεν ήταν μια ακόμα startup με αμφιλεγόμενη ”πολιτική απορρήτου” στα ψιλά γράμματα αλλά μια υποδομή για τις ανάγκες του κινήματος φτιαγμένη από σύντροφους και συντρόφισσες.


Το ιστορικό των τελευταίων εβδομάδων είναι ενδεικτικό του αυταρχισμού που μετατρέπει τον ψηφιακό (και όχι μόνο) κόσμο σε δυστοπία. Στις 26 Αυγούστου 2026, το αμερικανικό Υπουργείο Οικονομικών επέβαλε κυρώσεις στο A/I

χαρακτηρίζοντάς το “παγκόσμια τρομοκρατική οργάνωση”

, με βάση κατηγορίες που η ίδια η κολεκτίβα κατέρριψε στην ολότητά τους. Λίγες μέρες μετά, η Banca Etica — τράπεζα που διαφημίζεται ως “ηθική” και φιλική στην κοινωνική οικονομία — ανέστειλε και στη συνέχεια έκλεισε μονομερώς τον λογαριασμό του A/I, κρατώντας δεσμευμένα χρήματα που είχαν συγκεντρωθεί από δωρεές χιλιάδων ανθρώπων και συλλογικοτήτων. Χωρίς πρόσβαση σε κεφάλαια, χωρίς τη δυνατότητα να πληρώσει τους παρόχους του, και με το domain autistici.org να έχει ήδη γίνει απροειδοποίητα μη προσβάσιμο, το A/I κατέληξε στην απόφαση να κλείσει, για να προστατέψει τα μέλη και τις χρήστριές του από περαιτέρω έκθεση στον κρατικό αυταρχισμό.


Αυτή η ιστορία δεν αφορά μόνο μια οργάνωση στην Ιταλία. Αποκαλύπτει με τον πιο ωμό τρόπο πώς λειτουργεί σήμερα το ίντερνετ: ως υποδομή ελέγχου, όχι απελευθέρωσης. Η κατηγορία της “τρομοκρατίας” χρησιμοποιείται πλέον ανοιχτά για να ποινικοποιήσει την ίδια την ιδέα της ψηφιακής ιδιωτικότητας και της ανωνυμίας. Το χρηματοπιστωτικό σύστημα (τράπεζες, επεξεργαστές πληρωμών, ακόμα και τράπεζες που αυτοπαρουσιάζονται ως “εναλλακτικές”) λειτουργεί ως προέκταση της κρατικής καταστολής, ικανό να στραγγαλίσει οικονομικά οποιοδήποτε εγχείρημα θεωρηθεί ενοχλητικό, χωρίς δίκη, χωρίς απόδειξη, χωρίς καν προειδοποίηση. Οι υποδομές του ίδιου του διαδικτύου (domains, DNS, hosting) παραμένουν συγκεντρωμένες σε λίγα χέρια, πάντα έτοιμα να εκτελέσουν την επόμενη εντολή αποκλεισμού.


Αυτό το προηγούμενο είναι επικίνδυνο για όλους μας. Αν ένα εγχείρημα σαν το A/I (διαφανές, μη κερδοσκοπικό, με 25 χρόνια ιστορίας) μπορεί να εξαφανιστεί μέσα σε δύο εβδομάδες με μια υπογραφή κρατικού αξιωματούχου, τότε καμία αυτόνομη υποδομή αλληλεγγύης δεν είναι ασφαλής. Το δικαίωμα στην κρυπτογραφημένη, ανώνυμη επικοινωνία δεν είναι πολυτέλεια για “παρανοϊκούς”· είναι προϋπόθεση επιβίωσης για κινήματα, συλλογικότητες και άτομα που βρίσκονται στο στόχαστρο κρατών και της φασιστικής διεθνούς που έχει συγκροτηθεί από το τραμπικό καθεστώς και από δισεκατομμυριούχους και tech-bros όπως ο Elon Musk και ο Peter Thiel. Είναι επίσης δικαίωμα κάθε ανθρώπου να θέλει να μην παρακολουθείται το σύνολο των επικοινωνιών του από τις εταιρείες ή το κράτος. Η επίθεση στο A/I είναι επίθεση σε αυτό ακριβώς το δικαίωμα.


Γι’ αυτό επιμένουμε: χρειαζόμαστε ένα ίντερνετ μακριά από κράτος και κεφάλαιο. Αποκεντρωμένες, αυτοδιαχειριζόμενες υποδομές, ελεύθερο λογισμικό, δίκτυα αλληλεγγύης ανάμεσα σε hacklabs και συλλογικότητες που μοιράζονται τεχνογνωσία και πόρους αντί να εξαρτώνται από εταιρικά ή κρατικά serverfarm, εργαλεία ψηφιακής αυτοάμυνας φτιαγμένα από κόσμο που εμπιστεύεται ο κόσμος, όχι από πλατφόρμες που πουλάνε δεδομένα ή συμμορφώνονται με κάθε κυβερνητικό αίτημα. Η επιτήρηση, η καταστολή και ο έλεγχος είναι κομμάτια της εξουσίας που θέλουμε να καταργήσουμε.


Στέλνουμε την αλληλεγγύη μας στο Autistici/Inventati, στα μέλη του και σε όλες τις κοινότητες που στήριξε επί 25 χρόνια. Το “Stay human” που αφήσατε πίσω σας θα συνεχίσει να μας εμπνέει. Το κλείσιμό σας δεν είναι ήττα του κινήματος αλλά υπενθύμιση ότι πρέπει να

χτίσουμε περισσότερες, πιο διάχυτες, πιο δύσκολο να χτυπηθούν υποδομές

, εδώ στη Θεσσαλονίκη και παντού. Ο αγώνας συνεχίζεται.
